items.title: DXC in advanced talks to sell insurance software unit for $2.4 billion, sources say
items.author: Milana Vinn
items.creator: Milana Vinn
items.summary: IT services company DXC Technology is in advanced talks to sell its insurance software and services division to private investment firm Eldridge Industries for about $2.4 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
IT services company DXC Technology (DXC.N) is in advanced talks to sell its insurance software and services division to private investment firm Eldridge Industries for about $2.4 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
Eldridge is discussing combining the business with Zinnia, its insurance technology platform that provides software and digital infrastructure to life insurance and annuity providers, the sources said.
An agreement could be reached in the coming weeks, although there is no certainty a deal will be finalized, the people said, requesting anonymity because the discussions are confidential.
DXC Technology, Eldridge and Zinnia did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

items.title: Amazon diz que chips próprios de IA serão compatíveis com PyTorch
items.author: Stephen Nellis
items.creator: Stephen Nellis
items.summary: A Amazon.com está lançando uma nova ferramenta que permite que seus microprocessadores de inteligência artificial personalizados executem códigos baseados na biblioteca de programação de IA PyTorch, sem necessidade de modificações.
items.body:
A Amazon.com (AMZN.O) está lançando uma nova ferramenta que permite que seus microprocessadores de inteligência artificial personalizados executem códigos baseados na biblioteca de programação de IA PyTorch, sem necessidade de modificações.
As ações da empresa subiram 5% nas negociações da manhã desta segunda-feira, com o Morgan Stanley classificando a ação da Amazon como “top pick”.
O TorchNeuron permite que programadores executem código escrito com a PyTorch nos chips de IA Trainium da Amazon com uma única alteração de configuração e sem a necessidade de reescrever programas, de acordo com a unidade de chips Annapurna Labs da Amazon.
A Amazon, que planeja anunciar o software em uma conferência de desenvolvedores no Vale do Silício nesta segunda-feira, afirmou que a ferramenta será lançada publicamente como uma oferta gratuita e de código aberto.
O PyTorch, a biblioteca de código aberto apoiada pela Meta (META.O) , é usado pela maioria dos programadores de IA. A Nvidia dedicou mais de uma década à sua ferramenta de software chamada Cuda, que faz com que o PyTorch funcione bem nos chips da Nvidia.
Outras empresas de computação em nuvem, como o Google (GOOGL.O) , que também possui seus próprios chips de IA personalizados, estão trabalhando para atrair desenvolvedores da Nvidia com ferramentas melhores para a PyTorch.
Colin Brace, vice-presidente de software da Annapurna Labs, disse que a iniciativa visa reduzir o número de etapas que os desenvolvedores de IA precisam seguir para testar os chips desenvolvidos internamente pela Amazon.
“O objetivo tem sido atender aos clientes onde eles estão”, disse ele à Reuters em uma entrevista.
Brace disse que mais de 30 dos primeiros clientes, abrangendo robótica, modelos mundiais e IA de voz, estão usando o novo software, e que a migração para os chips da Amazon pode resultar em uma economia significativa de custos.

items.title: Flick clarifies Barcelona backline options before PSG and Real Madrid showdowns
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Hansi Flick has confirmed that Raphinha could return to Barcelona's starting XI against Paris St Germain on Tuesday in the Champions League, amid a defensive injury crisis.
items.body:
Hansi Flick has confirmed that Raphinha could return to Barcelona's starting XI against Paris St Germain on Tuesday in the Champions League, amid a defensive injury crisis.
The Catalan club lost both Jules Kounde and Eric Garcia to injury on Sunday, leaving them with just five fit senior defenders.
Raphinha could make first start for Barcelona since September 19 after hamstring issue.
Garcia, Kounde and Andreas Christensen will all miss blockbuster PSG clash through injury.
Flick says Kounde will be back "soon" and could play against Real Madrid on Sunday.
Midfielders Rodri Hernandez and Frenkie de Jong cited by Flick as makeshift options for backline.
Teenage centre back Alex Campos in squad for PSG game. The 18-year-old has yet to make Barcelona debut.

items.title: S&P Global advierte de que es probable que "hiperescaladores" tengan más deuda de la que se conoce
items.author: Marc Jones
items.creator: Marc Jones
items.summary: S&P Global dijo que es probable que las mayores empresas tecnológicas del mundo tengan más pasivos relacionados con la inteligencia artificial (IA) de lo que se conoce, pero su principal analista del sector no ve necesidad de modificar ninguna calificación por el momento.
items.body:
S&P Global dijo que es probable que las mayores empresas tecnológicas del mundo tengan más pasivos relacionados con la inteligencia artificial (IA) de lo que se conoce, pero su principal analista del sector no ve necesidad de modificar ninguna calificación por el momento.
La calidad de la deuda emitida por los proveedores de infraestructura de IA y las llamadas empresas "neocloud", como CoreWeave —respaldada por Nvidia—, ha caído a niveles cada vez más críticos en las últimas semanas, en un escenario de preocupación por la magnitud de su endeudamiento.
Mark Habib, director global de Infraestructura Digital de S&P, dijo que el mayor riesgo para las calificaciones de los hiperescaladores sigue siendo que los beneficios previstos no se materialicen.
Sin embargo, también destacó las denominadas "estructuras de financiación interconectadas", en las que los hiperescaladores garantizan de hecho la construcción de enormes centros de datos o el funcionamiento de empresas de IA más pequeñas.
"Es seguro suponer que hay más (deuda) ahí fuera que no estamos viendo", dijo Habib durante una mesa redonda celebrada en Londres.
"Si no se declara, entonces no forma parte de la información facilitada por los hiperescaladores. Además, si no calificamos las transacciones en las que puede devengarse este pasivo, lo cierto es que es posible que no tengamos visibilidad al respecto".
S&P prevé que los seis principales hiperescaladores estadounidenses —Amazon (AMZN.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Oracle (ORCL.N) , Meta (META.O) y SpaceX (SPCX.O) — gasten más de 7 billones de dólares en centros de datos y otras inversiones de capital relacionadas con la IA entre 2025 y 2030, y que tengan un flujo de caja libre negativo al menos hasta el año que viene.
Habib señaló que no existía una estimación de cuánta deuda más podría suponer la financiación circular para los balances de las empresas, pero añadió que S&P estaba tratando de adoptar una visión "holística".

items.title: Sentiment improved, but new tariffs weigh on business outlook: BoC report
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The Bank of Canada’s latest outlook survey suggested that business sentiment improved on average in Q3, although concerns remained about rising costs.
items.body: OTTAWA — The Bank of Canada’s latest outlook survey suggested that business sentiment improved on average in the third quarter, although concerns remained about rising costs and the war in the Middle East. However, about three-quarters of the interviews with businesses for the survey took place before trade talks between Canada and the United States broke down at the end of August and new Canadian counter-tariffs were announced. It says after the trade talks broke down, firms cited new U.S. tariffs on some goods and Canadian counter‑tariffs as factors weighing on their outlooks. The Bank of Canada says inflation expectations have risen alongside the new tariffs and the recent increase in energy prices. “The tariffs are also dampening business sentiment, weakening outlooks for exports and investment, and putting upward pressure on costs and prices,” the bank said in its report. The business outlook survey was conducted by in-person, video and phone interviews from Aug. 6 to Sept. 2. The bank said that at the time of the survey, a lessening of the drag from both trade tensions and geopolitical uncertainty in the Middle East helped firms report better sales outlooks than in the second quarter. The outlook survey said that roughly half the firms planned to continue passing some or all cost increases on to customers and that for several firms, those plans reflected somewhat improved demand and efforts to make up for past margin compression. At the same time, more companies than in the previous quarter said competitive pressures continue to limit their ability to increase prices. The report also noted that business investment intentions eased slightly, but remained robust with improvements in demand conditions supporting investment plans overall. In a separate report, also done mostly before the trade talks broke down, the Bank of Canada says its Canadian survey of consumer expectations found long-term inflation expectations rose to match those for the short term. The consumer report also says consumers reported better financial health than in the previous quarter, though high prices and economic uncertainty continue to weigh on Canadians. The reports comes ahead of the Bank of Canada’s next interest rate decision and monetary policy report set to be released on Oct. 28. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 19, 2026.

items.title: イスラエル、ガザへの商業物資搬入再開へ　税巡る対立解消
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ １９日 ロイター] - イスラエルは１９日、パレスチナ自治区ガザへの商業物資の搬入を再開すると発表した。援助に依存するガザへの食料など生活必需品の重要な供給ルートが復活する。物資搬入は、パレスチナのイスラム組織ハマスと商人の間の課税を巡る対立で数日間停止していた。

ガザでの人道問題を管轄するイスラエル軍機関「ＣＯＧＡＴ」は、ハマス当局がトラック１台当たり１万シェケル（３２２５ドル）の支払い要求を取り下げたと商人側が報告したことを受け、再開を決定したと説明した。

ＣＯＧＡＴは「調整の再開は、停戦合意の人道的条項を順守するというイスラエルの約束に沿って実施される」と表明した。商人側の説明は独自には確認できていないとした上で、搬入は段階的に再開し、冬を前に生活必需品が優先されるとした。

支払いが銀行振込を通じてのみ行われ、記録に残る形で授受されるよう監視を強化する。ハマスに支払いを行ったことが判明した商人はシステムから排除されるという。

ハマスは、１万シェケルの費用は戦禍で荒廃した地域で困窮者を支援する「基金」への裕福なガザ住民による任意の拠出だと説明している。

items.title: US Supreme Court seeks government's input on Iowa immigration arrest law
items.author: Daniel Wiessner
items.creator: Daniel Wiessner
items.summary: The US Supreme Court on Monday asked President Donald Trump's administration to weigh in on whether it should review a lower court ruling that blocked an Iowa law allowing state officials to arrest and prosecute people who are in the United States illegally.
items.body:
The US Supreme Court on Monday asked President Donald Trump's administration to weigh in on whether it should review a lower court ruling that blocked an Iowa law allowing state officials to arrest and prosecute people who are in the United States illegally.
Iowa is appealing [USN:L2N3OK0TE TEXT:"an 8th US Circuit Court of Appeals decision"] that said the Republican-led state's 2024 law interferes with federal immigration enforcement
The law makes it a crime to enter Iowa for anyone who has been previously deported or denied entry to the United States
The Supreme Court asked for the US Solicitor General's views on whether it should take the case brought by advocacy group Iowa Migrant Movement for Justice and two state residents who had previously been deported or otherwise removed from the US but were allowed to reenter as lawful permanent residents
Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird's office says that the law supplements federal enforcement and plaintiffs lack standing to sue
Former President Joe Biden's administration [USN:L1N3IG0HE TEXT:"sued Iowa"], Texas and other states for passing immigration enforcement laws
The Trump administration has supported the states' efforts
The case is Bird v. Iowa Migrant Movement for Justice, US Supreme Court, No. 26-49.
For Iowa: Iowa Solicitor General Eric Wessan
For the plaintiffs: Cody Wofsy of the American Civil Liberties Union Foundation
Read more:
[USN:L2N3OK0TE TEXT:"US court upholds block on Iowa immigrant arrest law"]
[USN:L1N3IG0HE TEXT:"Iowa immigration law blocked in Biden administration lawsuit"]
[USN:L1N42700K TEXT:"Court clears way for Texas to enforce migrant arrest law"]

items.title: WTA roundup: Lilli Tagger ousts Liudmila Samsonova in Osaka opener
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Austria's Lilli Tagger improved to 2-0 this year against Liudmila Samsonova of Russia with a 6-3, 6-3 upset of the No. 5 seed in the first round of the Japan Open on Monday in Osaka.
items.body:
Austria's Lilli Tagger improved to 2-0 this year against Liudmila Samsonova of Russia with a 6-3, 6-3 upset of the No. 5 seed in the first round of the Japan Open on Monday in Osaka.
Tagger converted all three break points while not facing any on her serve, finishing with more than twice as many winners as unforced errors (19-9) in the 72-minute victory.
It wasn't the only upset of the day, as Ashlyn Krueger ousted sixth-seeded Janice Tjen of Indonesia 6-4, 6-4. Krueger came away with the only breaks of the match at 4-4 in the first set and 3-3 in the second, winning 81% of her first-serve points and 80% of her second-serve points.
No. 4 Talia Gibson of Australia was the only seeded competitor to win her opener Monday, edging Great Britain's Harriet Dart 7-5, 7-6 (6). Austria's Sinja Kraus was leading 6-4, 3-1, when Caty McNally retired. Lanlanna Tararudee of Thailand and Switzerland's Viktorija Golubic also won in straight sets, while eighth-seeded Brit Katie Boulter led 6-3, 3-1 over Japan's Himeno Sakatsume when play was suspended due to rain.
Ningbo Open
Leylah Fernandez of Canada rallied for a 2-6, 6-3, 7-5 defeat of seventh-seeded Belgian Elise Mertens in a first-round match in China.
Fernandez overcame a sloppy performance, which saw her pair one ace with 11 double faults and 28 winners with 42 unforced errors. She saved seven of 14 break points while converting seven of 12 in the 2-hour, 49-minute battle.
No. 8 seed Sorana Cirstea of Romania, the only other seeded competitor in action, swept China's Han Shi 6-3, 6-2. Alexandra Eala of the Philippines beat France's Diane Parry 6-3, 6-1 and Czech Marie Bouzkova beat Kamilla Rakhimova of Uzbekistan 6-4, 6-4 to set up a second-round match against No. 2 seed Iga Swiatek of Poland. Belarus' Aliaksandra Sasnovich bested Australia's Daria Kasatkina 6-4, 6-2.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Elecciones Brasil 2026: si gana Bolsonaro, la derecha sumaría ocho victorias presidenciales en América Latina desde 2025
items.author: Carlos Cuevas
items.summary: La segunda vuelta entre Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y Flávio Bolsonaro definirá quién gobernará la mayor economía de América Latina durante los próximos cuatro años, con implicaciones que van más allá d ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — La cuenta regresiva comenzó: falta menos de una semana para la segunda vuelta presidencial en Brasil, una elección que definirá el rumbo político de la mayor economía de América Latina durante los próximos cuatro años y podría alterar el equilibrio político regional. Ver más: Juez de Brasil ordena a Meta dar el mismo trato a Lula y Bolsonaro antes de la segunda vuelta electoral Un triunfo del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva daría un respiro a la izquierda latinoamericana, que ha sufrido duros golpes electorales en los dos últimos años, mientras que una victoria del senador Flávio Bolsonaro ratificaría el avance de una creciente ola de derecha alineada con Donald Trump. La derecha y la centroderecha ganaron tres elecciones presidenciales en 2026 y cuatro en 2025. Este año, Abelardo de la Espriella ganó la segunda vuelta presidencial en Colombia el 21 de junio, mientras que Keiko Fujimori fue elegida presidenta de Perú en la segunda vuelta del 7 de junio. En Costa Rica, Laura Fernández ganó las elecciones presidenciales en primera vuelta el 1 de febrero. En 2025, José Antonio Kast ganó la segunda vuelta presidencial en Chile, Daniel Noboa fue reelegido en Ecuador, Rodrigo Paz venció en un balotaje sin precedentes en Bolivia y Nasry Asfura fue declarado presidente electo de Honduras. La izquierda, por su parte, venció por última vez el 25 de noviembre de 2024, con el heredero político de Pepe Mujica en Uruguay, Yamandú Orso. Lula, que esperaba ganar en primera vuelta, terminó siendo aventajado por Bolsonaro por más de dos millones de votos y partió con desventaja de cara a la segunda vuelta, que se celebrará el 25 de octubre. Pero el líder del Partido de los Trabajadores ha estado remontando en la intención de voto, en buena medida impulsado por la aprobación en el Legistativo de la reducción de la jornada laboral a 40 horas semanales, una propuesta que él impulsó. Bolsonaro superaba a Lula en las encuestas tras la primera vuelta por entre cuatro y seis puntos porcentuales. Ahora, sigue adelantándolo, pero el margen es menor. Hoy, Bolsonaro obtendría el 50,3% de los votos válidos, frente al 49,7% de Lula, excluyendo los votos en blanco y nulos , según una encuesta de BTG Pactual/Nexus. El margen de error de dos puntos. En una encuesta de Datafolha publicada el viernes, Bolsonaro obtendría el 51% de los votos válidos y Lula el 49%. Y en otra, de PoderData/Aya, ambos empatarían con 50% de los votos válidos. La intención de voto en Brasil podría cambiar tras un acalorado debate presidencial entre Bolsonaro y Lula el 18 de octubre. Uno de los intercambios más tensos se produjo cuando Bolsonaro cuestionó a Lula por el supuesto respaldo electoral que recibe de la población carcelaria. El senador afirmó que el 73% de los presos había votado por el presidente, quien respondió con ironía: “Yo quiero que vote el 100%, incluido tu padre”, en referencia al expresidente Jair Bolsonaro. Más adelante, Bolsonaro respondió con críticas a las relaciones de Lula con dirigentes como Daniel Ortega, de Nicaragua, y Nicolás Maduro, de Venezuela. Como en otros países de Latinoamérica, el manejo de la inseguridad y la manera en que los candidatos proponen combatir al crimen organizado sería determinante a medida que se acerca la convocatoria a las urnas. Lula propone fortalecer el Sistema Único de Seguridad Pública (SUSP) para integrar y coordinar las acciones de seguridad entre los distintos niveles de gobierno. También plantea R$10.000 millones (US$1.900 millones) en financiamiento reembolsable del Fondo Nacional de Inversión en Infraestructura Social (FIIS) para que los estados inviertan en infraestructura y equipamiento de seguridad. Bolsonaro promete declarar al Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC), al Comando Vermelho (CV), las milicias y otras facciones como organizaciones narcoterroristas, así como bloquear sus activos para atacar sus fuentes de financiación. Y quiere construir cinco nuevas cárceles federales de máxima seguridad, inspiradas en el modelo de El Salvador, y crear 500.000 nuevas plazas en el sistema penitenciario en cuatro años. items.title: Acciones europeas caen ante deterioro de confianza provocado por disturbios en Francia
items.author: Avinash P, Niket Nishant
items.creator: Avinash P, Niket Nishant
items.summary: Las acciones francesas registraron el lunes su peor jornada en casi dos semanas tras los disturbios que estallaron en varias ciudades del país durante el fin de semana, lo que lastró a las bolsas europeas.
items.body:
Las acciones francesas registraron el lunes su peor jornada en casi dos semanas tras los disturbios que estallaron en varias ciudades del país durante el fin de semana, lo que lastró a las bolsas europeas.
* El índice de valores CAC 40 (.FCHI) de Francia cayó un 1,1%, mientras que el índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) retrocedió un 0,9%, a 639,1 puntos.
* Las protestas, provocadas por el aumento de los precios y el deterioro de los servicios públicos, han empañado la confianza de los inversores hacia un país que ya se enfrenta a un crecimiento débil y a una deuda creciente.
* La agitación en la segunda economía más grande de la zona del euro, que se suma a la incertidumbre política de cara a las elecciones presidenciales de 2027, también ha sido en parte responsable de que el índice STOXX 600 se haya mantenido estancado en un estrecho rango durante el último mes.
* Las entidades bancarias francesas BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) , Société Générale (SOGN.PA) y Crédit Agricole (CAGR.PA) registraron caídas de entre el 2,5% y el 3,4%. La cadena minorista Carrefour (CARR.PA) bajó un 2,2% y el operador de centros comerciales Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield (URW.PA) cedió un 2%.
* La incertidumbre política también cobró protagonismo en España, donde el índice bursátil de referencia (.IBEX) cayó un 1,5%. Las elecciones anticipadas previstas para el próximo mes han generado recelo entre los inversores.
* Los partidos de extrema izquierda españoles presentaron el sábado listas de candidatos independientes para las elecciones, lo que reduce las posibilidades del presidente del Gobierno, el socialista Pedro Sánchez, de mantenerse en el poder al frente de una coalición de izquierdas.
* Los sectores cíclicos lideraron las caídas en toda Europa, siendo los bancos (.SX7E) los que más se resintieron con un descenso del 2,2%. Las acciones del sector de la defensa (.SXPARO) también se vieron sometidas a presión, con una caída del 1,5%.
* El índice tecnológico (.SX8P) se mantuvo en terreno positivo, con un alza del 0,7%. La semana pasada, las acciones europeas resistieron mejor que sus homólogas estadounidenses durante una ola de ventas en los valores relacionados con la inteligencia artificial, provocada por la preocupación ante el aumento de la deuda para financiar el gasto en infraestructuras.
* Entre los valores que más han destacado, Barclays (BARC.L) cayó un 3,5%, alcanzando su nivel más bajo desde mediados de junio.
* El Banco de Inglaterra investiga si los operadores de Barclays falsearon la información sobre préstamos de crédito privado ilíquidos para subestimar su riesgo, después de que una fuente interna del banco británico expresó su preocupación, informó el Financial Times, citando a personas familiarizadas con el asunto.

items.title: Bonfires of electric bikes burn in Paris riots
items.author: Ronan Corcoran
items.creator: Ronan Corcoran
items.summary: As protests rock France, the sight of electric bikes burning has become commonplace in the unrest.
items.body:
As [USN:L1N4650EF TEXT:"protests rock France"], the sight of electric bikes burning has become commonplace in the unrest.
In Paris, black smoke and flames rose over piles of the e-bikes at the weekend. Elsewhere in the city, a protester threw an e-bike onto a burning car.
Shared-mobility operator Dott said in a statement to Reuters on Monday that about 300 of its electric bikes were destroyed and 120 severely damaged in Paris during the [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"nationwide protests"] on Saturday, which turned violent in several cities. It has 6,000 bikes in the city.
The company also said 80 vehicles, including bikes and scooters, were destroyed in Bordeaux and 30 to 40 scooters in Lyon. It estimated the damage at around €400,000 ($450,000).
Lime said some of its shared bicycles and scooters in Paris were destroyed or damaged during the protests, with the company losing about 6% of its Paris fleet.
Ahead of the demonstrations, Lime said it worked with police to remove vehicles from designated protest routes and restricted parking and riding in several high-risk areas, adjusting those measures over the weekend as the situation evolved.
Velib, whose bikes are docked, rather than parked on pavements, said in a report in Le Parisien newspaper that around 5% of its fleet of 18,000 e-bikes was destroyed or damaged at the weekend. It did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Reuters.
E-bikes often use lithium-ion batteries, which can ignite and produce intense fires that spread rapidly and produce toxic smoke.
There was no indication that e-bike operators were specifically targeted during the protests over the cost of living and underfunded public services that have [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"descended into riots and looting"].
However, with thousands of bicycles available across Paris streets and docking stations, they proved readily accessible to protesters, with many used to build barricades or to set on fire.

items.title: Senators coach Travis Green signs multi-year extension
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Ottawa Senators signed head coach Travis Green to a multi-year contract extension on Monday.
items.body:
The Ottawa Senators signed head coach Travis Green to a multi-year contract extension on Monday.
Four other members of the coaching staff also received extensions with Ottawa off to a 6-3-0 start this season.
Green, 55, is 95-60-18 with two playoff berths since taking over in May 2024. The extension keeps him in the Canadian capital through the end of the 2030-31 campaign.
"When I was in the search to identify our head coach two years ago, it was clear to me that Travis had the qualities to move our team forward. I have watched him implement systems and structures that have reinforced my belief in his coaching abilities," said Steve Staios, Senators president of hockey operations and general manager. "We share the same vision and philosophy and are confident we can continue to build on our team."
Assistants Nolan Baumgartner, Ben Sexton and Mike Yeo and goaltending coach Justin Peters also received multi-year extensions.
Green owns a career record of 236-219-53 including stints with the Vancouver Canucks (2017-21) and as interim coach of the New Jersey Devils in 2024.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Aumenta contratación de empresas de servicios petroleros en Venezuela en primera oleada inversiones
items.author: Georgina Mccartney, Marianna Parraga
items.creator: Georgina Mccartney, Marianna Parraga
items.summary: Empresas de servicios petroleros como Weatherford International, Baker Hughes, Halliburton y SLB están ofreciendo decenas de nuevos puestos de trabajo en Venezuela, según portales de empleo, en una señal de que el plan de Washington de reconstruir la industria energética del país empieza a tomar forma.
items.body:
Empresas de servicios petroleros como Weatherford International, Baker Hughes, Halliburton y SLB están ofreciendo decenas de nuevos puestos de trabajo en Venezuela, según portales de empleo, en una señal de que el plan de Washington de reconstruir la industria energética del país empieza a tomar forma.
La contratación, que podría ayudar a revertir el éxodo de empresas y profesionales que se produjo durante la era de las sanciones, forma parte de los esfuerzos del Gobierno de Donald Trump por impulsar 100.000 millones de dólares en inversiones para el país tras la captura de Nicolás Maduro en enero.
Mientras algunos grandes productores indican que necesitan estabilidad política y reglas jurídicas claras antes de comprometer grandes inversiones, muchas firmas internacionales de servicios petroleros están dando los primeros pasos para desplegar personal y equipos especializados en el terreno.
Weatherford (WFRD.O) , que había reducido al mínimo su presencia en Venezuela en 2019, tiene al menos 20 vacantes abiertas -de supervisores de operaciones, especialistas en perforación, soldadores, ingenieros y personal para el área de ventas, entre otros- desde el mes pasado principalmente para los centros de operaciones de petróleo y gas de Anaco y Maturín.
La compañía estadounidense tiene previsto celebrar un evento este mes junto a Eni (ENI.MI) tras un acuerdo clave alcanzado en septiembre con la estatal PDVSA que permitirá a la petrolera italiana expandir operaciones en la Faja del Orinoco, dijo una fuente, que agregó que Eni está negociando una alianza con Weatherford para el proyecto.
Weatherford y Eni no respondieron a solicitudes de comentarios.
Baker Hughes (BKR.O) , que también se está expandiendo, tiene actualmente una docena de vacantes publicadas en su sitio web para puestos en Maracaibo, la segunda mayor región petrolera de Venezuela. La empresa firmó este mes un acuerdo clave con PDVSA, la firma de ingeniería Lindsayca y la desarrolladora Fulcrum LNG para reactivar infraestructura de gas en Venezuela.
Por su parte, SLB (SLB.N) tiene 35 vacantes en oferta en su sitio web para puestos en Anaco, Maturín y Caracas publicadas en los últimos seis meses. A principios de octubre, Halliburton (HAL.N) hizo pública su intención de ampliar su red de talento en Venezuela.
Un portavoz de Baker Hughes dijo que la empresa no hace comentarios sobre su personal. SLB declinó comentar, mientras que Halliburton no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.
Las ofertas de empleo representan una oportunidad para que profesionales venezolanos en el extranjero regresen al país, mientras que el personal que está trabajando en Venezuela podría negociar salarios más altos.
La mayoría de las empresas extranjeras de servicios petroleros habían cerrado o reducido operaciones en Venezuela tras la imposición de sanciones por parte de Estados Unidos en 2019, lo que conllevó al despido o transferencia de personal, así como al retiro de equipos del país.
EQUIPOS EN CAMINO Taladros y equipo especializado para los campos petroleros también están comenzando a hacerse visibles, aunque comenzando desde un nivel muy bajo. Según datos de Baker Hughes, este mes solo había dos taladros de perforación activos en Venezuela.
Equipos estadounidenses de segunda mano, incluidas decenas de taladros para reacondicionamiento de pozos -muchos de ellos adquiridos en subastas- han estado ingresando al país este año.
La firma North American Blue Energy Partners (NABEP), que cuenta con respaldo estadounidense, informó que la semana pasada recibió dos unidades de perforación. Por su parte, se espera que Chevron (CVX.N) active pronto cuatro equipos.
Patterson-UTI , uno de los mayores contratistas de perforación de Estados Unidos, está enviando componentes para 10 viejos equipos. Según su director ejecutivo, Andy Hendricks, se trata de un tipo de taladro que la empresa no ha utilizado en Estados Unidos desde hace unos 15 años. "Para Venezuela estarán bien", dijo en una entrevista la semana pasada.
Según Welligence Energy Analytics, se prevé que el despliegue de equipos en Venezuela se centrará principalmente en unidades de reacondicionamiento, destinadas a la reapertura y reparación de pozos en campos maduros, hasta finales de 2027.
Sumado a los planes de expansión de las grandes petroleras, este enfoque elevaría la producción de crudo a cerca de 1,5 millones de barriles por día (bpd) para finales de 2027, frente a los 1,2 millones de bpd actuales, señaló la consultora.
"Mantenemos un optimismo cauteloso", afirmó Andrés Armijos, director de Welligence para América Latina, en referencia al plan de inversiones y a las recientes ofertas de empleo. "En realidad, esto llevará tiempo".

items.title: First-ever TGL trade sends The Bay's Shane Lowry to Boston
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ireland's Shane Lowry moved from The Bay Golf Club to Boston Common Golf in the first trade in TGL history on Monday.
items.body:
Ireland's Shane Lowry moved from The Bay Golf Club to Boston Common Golf in the first trade in TGL history on Monday.
Lowry, winner of The Open Championship in 2019, joins good friend Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland in Boston's lineup.
In exchange, The Bay acquired Boston's fourth selection to fill its open roster slot this season. The Bay also receives one future selection over the next three offseasons plus additional "commercial considerations," the league said.
The move comes as TGL expands to five-player rosters for the 2027 season.
Boston Common opens the season on Jan. 2 against Los Angeles Golf Club.
"I'm delighted to be joining Boston Common Golf," Lowry said in a statement. "Having Rory alongside me and being part of this group makes it particularly exciting, and I'm looking forward to helping the team bring a championship to Boston."
Boston's roster last season featured McIlroy, Keegan Bradley, Australia's Adam Scott and Japan's Hideki Matsuyama.
"Shane is a fierce competitor with a tremendous all-around game, and I'm excited to have him on our side," Bradley said. "He brings the kind of energy that makes team golf fun, and he'll fit right in with this group. We're eager to get back to SoFi Center, and adding Shane gives us even more confidence as we chase a championship for Boston."
Lowry, 39, recorded his most recent professional win at the Irish Open last month on the DP World Tour.
The remaining members for The Bay Golf Club are Wyndham Clark, Sweden's Ludvig Aberg and Australia's Min Woo Lee.
"Shane helped build The Bay Golf Club from day one -- in the team room, on the course and with our fans and partners," said Eric Kwait, The Bay's team president. "He's a major champion, and one of the most genuine and beloved players in professional golf, and he'll always be part of our story. We wish Shane and his family nothing but success in the future."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Chopard presenta su reloj de oro del Día de Muertos 2026: tiene marquetería con cáscara de huevo y cuesta US$575.000
items.author: Isaac Garrido
items.summary: La nueva edición del L.U.C Full Strike requiere 160 horas de trabajo artesanal en marquetería de cáscara de huevo y paja.
items.body: El Día de Muertos es una de las celebraciones mexicanas más arraigadas y desde hace una década ha cobrado una relevancia internacional tan grande que incluso se ha colado al mundo de la alta relojería. Varias casas han lanzado ediciones conmemorativas inspiradas en la tradición, pero Chopard la ha adoptado con singularidad desde hace 13 años. Para este 2026, la firma preparó el L.U.C Full Strike “Día de los Muertos” Edition 13, un reloj de oro rosa que conmemora la celebración con una pieza que integra un diseño artesanal de marquetería de cáscara de huevo y de paja. Con esta técnica decorativa, que consiste en ensamblar pequeñas piezas de distintos materiales para crear patrones o dibujos, un solo maestro artesano da vida a una calavera que adorna la carátula del reloj. La minuciosa labor toma cerca de 160 horas de trabajo debido a la precisión que exige y la fragilidad de los materiales. La paja, por ejemplo, “se corta y se talla a mano antes de disponerla en diferentes calibres y orientaciones para evocar las líneas y los contornos de una calavera”, explicó un comunicado de la firma. La cáscara de huevo se ensambla fragmento por fragmento, se laca y se pule para darle uniformidad. “Alrededor de las órbitas, el artesano ha creado un efecto en degradé que deja entrever mejor el fondo de laca negra en el centro, mientras que la densidad de los fragmentos de cáscara va aumentando progresivamente hacia el exterior”. Esta imagen incluye también un singular bigote de oro grabado a mano con el nombre del modelo. A medio camino entre la alta relojería y el mundo de las artes decorativas todo lo anterior hace que esta pieza conmemorativa tenga un costo de US$575.000. Además de reunir la tradición del trabajo artesanal, esta edición del L.U.C Full Strike destaca el calibre L.U.C 08.01-L, el primer movimiento de repetición de minutos diseñado íntegramente por la Manufactura de Chopard. El desarrollo está respaldado por cinco patentes y para esta edición algunos elementos, como los martillos, el puente del engranaje de la sonería y el tambor del regulador de inercia de la repetición de minutos fueron sometidos a un tratamiento en CVD azul para ir acorde con el color de la paja. La caja del reloj está elaborada en oro rosa ético de 18 quilates, con un diámetro de 42,5 milímetros y un grosor de 11,55 milímetros. La corona, de 8,8 milímetros, está grabada a mano, al igual que la carrura y el bisel. La pieza incorpora un cristal de zafiro antirreflectante y un fondo abierto, pulido y grabado a mano.
items.raw_description: La nueva edición del L.U.C Full Strike requiere 160 horas de trabajo artesanal en marquetería de cáscara de huevo y paja.

items.title: Venezuela oilfield hiring picks up as first wave of investment builds
items.author: Georgina Mccartney, Marianna Parraga
items.creator: Georgina Mccartney, Marianna Parraga
items.summary: Oilfield service companies including Weatherford International , Baker Hughes , Halliburton and SLB are advertising dozens of jobs in Venezuela, according to company websites, an early sign that a Washington-backed plan to rebuild the country's energy industry is gaining traction.
items.body:
Oilfield service companies including Weatherford International (WFRD.O) , Baker Hughes (BKR.O) , Halliburton (HAL.N) and SLB (SLB.N) are advertising dozens of jobs in Venezuela, according to company websites, an early sign that a Washington-backed plan to rebuild the country's energy industry is gaining traction.
The hiring could help reverse a sanctions-era exodus of companies and professionals from the country and comes as the administration of US President Donald Trump pushes a $100 billion oil revival plan following the capture of then-President Nicolas Maduro in January.
With some major producers signaling they need political stability and clear legal rules before committing big money, international oil service firms are taking initial steps to put workers, rigs and equipment on the ground.
Weatherford, which had scaled back its presence in Venezuela in 2019, has at least 20 open positions, mostly for the oil and gas hubs of Anaco and Maturin, which it started advertising last month. The firm is seeking operation supervisors, drilling specialists and engineers, the company's career website page showed.
The US company is set to host a ceremony with Eni (ENI.MI) this month, a source said, following an [USN:L1N44U0HI TEXT:"agreement"] with state-run PDVSA in September for the Italian producer to expand at Venezuela's Orinoco Belt. Eni has engaged Weatherford to help increase production, the source said.
Weatherford and Eni did not reply to requests for comment.
Venezuela has the world's largest oil reserves, but it pumps only about 1.2 million barrels per day (bpd), a fraction of what those reserves could support.
Baker Hughes, which also is expanding in the country, has a dozen openings on its website, posting roles in Maracaibo — Venezuela's second-largest oil region. The company signed an agreement this month with PDVSA, engineering firm Lindsayca and developer Fulcrum LNG to reactivate gas infrastructure.
SLB, meanwhile, has 35 vacancies on its website for positions in Anaco, Maturin and Caracas, with postings dating back around six months.
Halliburton said in early October it was seeking to expand the company's talent network in Venezuela.
A Baker Hughes spokesperson said the company does not comment on personnel. SLB declined to comment. Halliburton did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Most foreign oil service firms had shut down or reduced operations in Venezuela following US sanctions in 2019, laying off or transferring staff and removing equipment from the country.
RIGS ON THE WAY Equipment is starting to return, though from a low base. Only two drilling rigs were active in Venezuela this month, according to Baker Hughes data.
US-backed North American Blue Energy Partners said it received two drilling units last week, and Chevron is expected to soon [USN:L6N4500X7 TEXT:"activate"] four.
One of the largest US land drilling contractors, Patterson-UTI (PTEN.O) , said it is currently shipping components for 10 older rigs of a type CEO Andy Hendricks said the company has not used in the US in about 15 years. "It'll be fine for Venezuela," he said in an interview last week.
Through the end of next year, deployments are expected to focus mostly on workover rigs to reopen and repair wells at mature fields, according to Welligence Energy Analytics. Combined with major oil firms' expansion plans, that approach would help lift crude output to some 1.5 million bpd by late 2027 from the 1.2 million bpd now, the consultancy said.
"We are being cautiously optimistic," said Andres Armijos, Welligence's head for Latin America, referring to the investment plan and recent job postings. "In reality, this will take time."
items.raw_description: Oilfield service companies including Weatherford International , Baker Hughes , Halliburton and SLB are advertising dozens of jobs in Venezuela, according to company websites, an early sign that a Washington-backed plan to rebuild the country's energy industry is gaining traction.

items.title: Kansas adds NBA draft pick Trey Kaufman-Renn to roster
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Trey Kaufman-Renn, the 59th overall pick by Minnesota in the 2026 NBA Draft in June, is officially on the Kansas roster as he seeks a sixth year of eligibility.
items.body:
Trey Kaufman-Renn, the 59th overall pick by Minnesota in the 2026 NBA Draft in June, is officially on the Kansas roster as he seeks a sixth year of eligibility.
Kaufman-Renn, 24, never signed a pro contract with the Timberwolves. As a second-round pick, contract agreements are not guaranteed in the NBA.
Last season, the 6-foot-9 forward averaged 14.2 points, 8.3 rebounds and 2.5 assists in 37 starts at Purdue.
Kaufman-Renn began practicing with the Jayhawks last week and received a temporary injunction to participate while hoping for another year of eligibility. He would take the roster spot of Grant Mordini, a freshman guard who suffered a season-ending patellar tendon injury in September.
"Trey Kaufman-Renn, who had a tremendous career at Purdue, has enrolled in classes, and is practicing with us as of Sunday," Kansas coach Bill Self said. "He reached the national championship game, the Elite Eight and the Sweet 16 at Purdue and has been extremely well-drilled and well-coached. Even though it's late in the process, because of his basketball IQ, we think his transition will be quicker than most put in the same circumstance."
The Jayhawks open the regular season at home against Fordham on Nov. 2.
Kaufman-Renn played in 147 games (112 starts) over four seasons with the Boilermakers, averaging 11.3 points, 5.2 rebounds and 1.6 assists. He redshirted his first year on campus and was a first-team All-Big Ten selection in 2024-25.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Higher gas prices drove inflation up to 3.1% in September: StatCan
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The annual pace of inflation rose to 3.1 per cent in September as war in the Middle East continued to drive up gas prices, Statistics Canada said Monday.
items.body: OTTAWA — Canada’s annual inflation rate rose to 3.1 per cent in September as war in the Middle East continued to drive up gasoline prices, but economists say easing core inflation suggests higher energy costs have yet to spread widely throughout the economy. Statistics Canada said Monday the acceleration in headline inflation was led by a 27.8 per cent spike in gasoline prices last month compared with a year earlier, despite the switch to the less expensive winter gas blend. Excluding gasoline, however, consumer prices increased 2.2 per cent year-over-year in September after a 2.4 per cent rise in August. BMO chief economist Douglas Porter said while soaring gasoline prices are pushing inflation above the Bank of Canada’s target, underlying price pressures remain relatively contained. “The fact that a lot of measures of core inflation are holding steady at around two per cent suggests that the run-up in prices really is not spreading far and wide beyond the gasoline pump,” he said in an interview. “Overall inflation actually came in a just a little bit lower than what had been expected and there were lots of somewhat encouraging developments.” Economists had broadly expected inflation to accelerate to 3.2 per cent last month, up from three per cent in August, putting pressure on the Bank of Canada ahead of its next interest rate decision on Oct. 28. Yet Porter said the consumer price index report on its own “does nothing to advance the case for interest rate hikes.” The latest Statistics Canada inflation data showed moderation in grocery prices, with food purchased from stores up 1.7 per cent in September. That is the smallest yearly increase since May 2024. Driving the slowdown was a 2.9 per cent drop in prices for fresh vegetables, while sugar and confectionery items fell 2.7 per cent. Beef prices rose at a slower pace in September, up 8.7 per cent compared with an 11 per cent increase in August. Despite the year-over-year slowdown, prices for groceries have jumped 33 per cent since September 2020. September brought the yearly update to tuition fees, which rose 2.4 per cent following a 1.7 per cent increase in 2025, Statistics Canada said. Even though most tourism-related sectors saw normal seasonal price drops, ticket prices for flights surged 19.4 per cent in September, primarily because of escalating jet fuel costs. Meanwhile, September saw a wide divergence in inflation between regions. For example, inflation for all three Maritime provinces was above five per cent amid heating oil spikes. The agency said fuel oil and other fuels surged 57.8 per cent in September, hitting consumers hard in Atlantic Canada where many homes are heated with oil. Inflation in Ontario came in at 2.5 per cent in September, the lowest in the country. Porter said the wide gaps reflect deep differences in housing markets, as well as the downward pressure on central Canada due to trade issues with the United States. “We’ve got some really extreme regional variations across the country, and it’s showing up in the inflation numbers,” he said. Statistics Canada said measures of core inflation, which offer a clearer picture of underlying price trends by filtering out big price swings, eased slightly last month. The agency’s so-called CPI-trim, which excludes the biggest price increases and decreases, fell to 1.8 per cent year-over-year in September from 1.9 per cent in August. CPI-median, a measure of the midpoint of price changes across goods and services, declined to 1.9 per cent from two per cent. Andrew Grantham, senior economist with CIBC Capital Markets, said in a client note that the “hawkish tone” of Bank of Canada governor Tiff Macklem’s comments over the weekend had raised market expectations of an interest rate hike later this month. But the inflation report “suggests that there is little rush and policymakers can take more time to assess how U.S. trade relations and the impact of new tariffs develop before raising rates,” Grantham said. During a media roundtable from Thailand on Saturday, Macklem warned that persistently high energy prices were increasing the risk of broader inflation and that the central bank was prepared to raise rates if necessary. He said the prevailing message from his peers at the International Monetary Fund meetings in Bangkok was that the global economy has been performing better than expected in the face of ongoing wars in Iran and Ukraine, sweeping trade disruptions and higher borrowing costs from rising bond yields. But Macklem also said that resilience is increasingly “under strain” as shocks like the Middle East conflict persist and drive up energy prices. Some of those sources of resilience — like releasing global oil reserves — are being depleted, he said. “You can only release strategic energy, oil reserves so many times, but that has helped contain this energy price shock,” Macklem said. --- Brett Bundale, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 19, 2026.
items.raw_description: The annual pace of inflation rose to 3.1 per cent in September as war in the Middle East continued to drive up gas prices, Statistics Canada said Monday.

items.title: Solvay abaisse ses objectifs annuels, le conflit au Moyen-Orient pèse
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Solvay a abaissé lundi ses objectifs pour l'ensemble de l'année 2026, le groupe chimique belge prenant acte du fait que le conflit au Moyen-Orient et l'arrêt d'une usine de peroxyde en Arabie saoudite ont pesé sur ses résultats du seul troisième trimestre.
items.body:
Solvay (SOLB.BR) a abaissé lundi ses objectifs pour l'ensemble de l'année 2026, le groupe chimique belge prenant acte du fait que le conflit au Moyen-Orient et l'arrêt d'une usine de peroxyde en Arabie saoudite ont pesé sur ses résultats du seul troisième trimestre.
• L'entreprise table désormais sur un Ebitda (bénéfice avant intérêts, impôts, dépréciation et amortissement) annuel compris entre 720 et 740 millions d'euros et un flux de trésorerie disponible situé entre 120 et 150 millions d'euros.
• Le groupe anticipait précédemment un Ebitda sous-jacent compris entre 770 et 850 millions d'euros en 2026, et un flux de trésorerie d'au moins 200 millions d'euros.
• Le conflit au Moyen-Orient a eu un impact négatif d’environ 25 millions d'euros sur l’Ebitda sous-jacent au troisième trimestre, selon un communiqué du groupe.
• L'arrêt prolongé de l'usine Peroxides dans le complexe de Sadara à Jubail, en Arabie saoudite, a impacté le trimestre.
• Le groupe a enregistré sur la période un chiffre d’affaires net sous-jacent de 1,03 milliard d'euros, un Ebitda sous-jacent de 173 millions d'euros, et un flux de trésorerie aux actionnaires de Solvay des activités poursuivies de 54 millions d'euros.
• En raison de la "quiet period" en cours, Solvay ne fera pas d’autres commentaires avant la publication de ses résultats complets du troisième trimestre, le 4 novembre, précise le communiqué.

items.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe finit dans le rouge, pénalisée par les tensions après les événements en France
items.author: Coralie Lamarque
items.creator: Coralie Lamarque
items.summary: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en nette baisse lundi, face aux craintes d'instabilité politique et financière en France à la suite des scènes de chaos en marge de la mobilisation nationale de samedi contre la vie chère.
items.body:
Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en nette baisse lundi, face aux craintes d'instabilité politique et financière en France à la suite des scènes de chaos en marge de la mobilisation nationale de samedi contre la vie chère.
À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) a perdu 1,11% à 7.868,05 points. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) a lâché 1,18% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a cédé 1,08%.
L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) a reculé de 0,96%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,83% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,80%.
Les inquiétudes à la suite des pillages et des violences dans plusieurs villes en France, en marge des manifestations menées samedi contre la vie chère, se répercutent sur les marchés financiers européens, en attisant les craintes concernant la situation politique et financière de la deuxième économie du bloc européen.
Alors que les investisseurs étaient déjà préoccupés par le niveau de la dette publique française et le devenir du projet de budget 2027 actuellement débattu par les parlementaires, la tournure des évènements du week-end jette une nouvelle ombre sur la stabilité politique française auprès des opérateurs.
Le ministre de l'Intérieur, Laurent Nuñez, a présenté lundi sa démission, s'estimant "responsable de tout ce qui se passe", tandis que le président Emmanuel Macron l'a rejetée.
Le Premier ministre, Sébastien Lecornu, a déclaré pour sa part avoir donné instruction aux préfets d'instaurer des couvre-feux partiels et localisés, à la suite des violences et des pillages en marge de la mobilisation de samedi qui mêlait revendications des lycéens et mécontentement contre la vie chère.
Sébastien Lecornu a jugé qu'un recours à l'état d'urgence n'était pas d'actualité mais restait envisageable, tout en martelant sa détermination à "rétablir l'ordre".
Les tensions politiques exacerbent le marché de la dette souveraine française, l'écart entre les obligations allemandes et françaises à 10 ans se creusant à 147 points de base.
"Six mois supplémentaires de vide politique représentent une période particulièrement longue pour les marchés, l’économie et les entrepreneurs", a déclaré Kevin Thozet, membre du comité d'investissement de Carmignac, dans une note.
VALEURS À Paris, alors que la plupart des valeurs du SBF 120 (.SBF120) ont fini dans le rouge, Rubis (RUBF.PA) a gagné 2,6% après avoir annoncé [USN:L8N46505D TEXT:"lundi"] un projet de transformation en société anonyme dotée d’un directoire et d’un conseil de surveillance.
Les craintes politiques en France ont particulièrement pénalisé les banques, Crédit Agricole (CAGR.PA) et BNP (BNPP.PA) ayant reculé respectivement 2,64% et 2,48%. Lanterne rouge du CAC 40, Société Générale (SOGN.PA) a perdu 3,41%.
À WALL STREET À l'heure de la clôture en Europe, Wall Street évolue dans le vert. Le Dow Jones (.DJI) se retourne à la hausse et gagne 0,17%, tandis que le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) avance de 0,86% et le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) progresse de 1,73%.
LES INDICATEURS DU JOUR Aucun indicateur majeur n'était à l'agenda de lundi.
CHANGES La devise européenne subit les inquiétudes exacerbées concernant la situation budgétaire en France, la deuxième économie du bloc monétaire.
L'euro perd 0,27% à 1,1209 dollar , tandis que le dollar gagne 0,14% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) .
TAUX Le marché obligataire français est [USN:L8N4650B8 TEXT:"impacté"] par les craintes d'instabilité politique et financière attisées par les scènes de chaos observées ce week-end en marge de la mobilisation nationale.
Le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans s'est établi à 4,9291%. Le deux ans a atteint 3,6479%.
Le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans a terminé à 3,4540% et le deux ans à 3,0920%.
Le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans avance de 3,8 points de base à 5,1355%. Le deux ans gagne 3,4 points de base à 4,7698%.
PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers reculent légèrement, les investisseurs évaluant l'impact des dérogations accordées par les États-Unis concernant certaines sanctions et certains droits de douane pesant sur les exportations russes.
Le Brent cède 0,64% à 109,16 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) lâche 0,11% à 101,52 dollars.
À SUIVRE MARDI 20 OCTOBRE : [USN:L8N4621GO]

items.title: Christiane Amanpour to leave CNN after four decades as Ellison era begins
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: CNN chief international anchor Christiane Amanpour will leave next year, after 43 years with the network, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters on Monday.
items.body:
CNN chief international anchor Christiane Amanpour will leave next year, after 43 years with the network, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters on Monday.
The news channel has recently come under the ownership of Skydance (SKYD.N) , whose CEO David Ellison has faced criticism over his stewardship of CBS News.
Amanpour will end her daily shows across CNN and PBS at the end of this year
She will continue to host a weekly show on CNN through May and work on a transition through June
Amanpour, whose first major assignment was covering the first Gulf War, went on to report on conflicts in Bosnia, Rwanda, Afghanistan, Ukraine and Iran
Skydance, formerly Paramount Skydance, completed its [USN:L4N45S0XK TEXT:"$110 billion takeover"] of Warner Bros Discovery earlier this month, bringing CNN and CBS News under one roof
CNN chief Mark Thompson and CBS News Editor-in-Chief Bari Weiss [USN:L6N45R0R0 TEXT:"kept their roles"], with both reporting to Ellison and co-CEO Ynon Kreiz
Lawmakers have criticized Ellison for [USN:L1N43G10Q TEXT:"tailoring news coverage"] at CBS News to favor President Donald Trump

items.title: Brasil detecta la enfermedad de Newcastle en una granja de pavos de un estado del sur
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brasil detectó un caso de enfermedad de Newcastle en una granja de pavos del estado sureño de Santa Catarina, informó el lunes el ministro de Agricultura, André de Paula, quien añadió que se habían puesto en marcha medidas sanitarias que afectarían a 133 granjas de la región.
items.body:
Brasil detectó un caso de enfermedad de Newcastle en una granja de pavos del estado sureño de Santa Catarina, informó el lunes el ministro de Agricultura, André de Paula, quien añadió que se habían puesto en marcha medidas sanitarias que afectarían a 133 granjas de la región.
La enfermedad de Newcastle es altamente contagiosa y afecta a las aves, al igual que la gripe aviar.
Brasil es el mayor exportador mundial de carne de pollo.
Las autoridades brasileñas dijeron que están elaborando informes detallados y que compartirían toda la información relevante con los principales socios comerciales del país.
El secretario interino de Comercio Agrícola de Brasil, Rafael Requiao, señaló que es demasiado pronto aún para facilitar información concreta sobre posibles suspensiones de las importaciones.
China, uno de los principales destinos de las exportaciones de pollo de Brasil, impuso en 2024 un embargo a la carne de pollo procedente de Rio Grande do Sul tras confirmarse un caso de enfermedad de Newcastle en una granja comercial de ese estado, también del sur del país.

items.title: Israel reanudará los envíos comerciales a Gaza tras la disputa con Hamás sobre cobros
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israel anunció el lunes que volvería a permitir el envío de mercancías comerciales a Gaza tras una interrupción de varios días a raíz de una disputa fiscal entre Hamás y los comerciantes, restableciendo así una ruta clave para el suministro de alimentos y otros productos de primera necesidad a este enclave, que depende de la ayuda humanitaria.
items.body:
Israel anunció el lunes que volvería a permitir el envío de mercancías comerciales a Gaza tras una interrupción de varios días a raíz de una disputa fiscal entre Hamás y los comerciantes, restableciendo así una ruta clave para el suministro de alimentos y otros productos de primera necesidad a este enclave, que depende de la ayuda humanitaria.
La COGAT, la agencia militar israelí encargada de supervisar los asuntos humanitarios en Gaza, dijo que tomó la decisión después de que los comerciantes informaron que las autoridades de Hamás habían retirado la exigencia de pagos de 10.000 shekels (3.225 dólares) por camión.
"La reanudación de la coordinación se está llevando a cabo de conformidad con el compromiso de Israel con las disposiciones humanitarias del acuerdo de alto el fuego", afirmó.
La COGAT señaló que los informes de los comerciantes no se habían verificado de forma independiente y que los envíos se reanudarían de forma gradual, dando prioridad a los productos de primera necesidad de cara al invierno.
Se reforzará la supervisión para garantizar que los pagos se realicen y se reciban únicamente a través de transferencias bancarias documentadas, y cualquier comerciante del que se compruebe que ha pagado a Hamás se enfrentará a la exclusión del sistema.
Hamás afirmó que la cuota de 10.000 shekels era una contribución voluntaria de los habitantes de Gaza con mayor poder adquisitivo a un fondo nacional destinado a apoyar a las personas necesitadas en el territorio devastado por la guerra.
La mayoría de los habitantes de Gaza siguen dependiendo de la ayuda luego de tres años de guerra, desplazamientos repetidos y severas restricciones en el envío de ayuda. Aunque el alto el fuego negociado por Estados Unidos el año pasado detuvo los combates más intensos, no ha puesto fin a los ataques israelíes.
Las autoridades sanitarias locales dijeron el lunes que al menos cinco palestinos, entre ellos un niño de 14 años, murieron en distintos ataques israelíes en la ciudad de Gaza y en Jan Yunis. El Ejército israelí no hizo comentarios de inmediato.
Israel dice que Hamás ha seguido rearmándose y llevando a cabo ataques en violación del alto el fuego, mientras que Hamás acusa a Israel de socavar el acuerdo.
Las autoridades sanitarias de Gaza dicen que unos 1.500 palestinos han perdido la vida a causa de los disparos israelíes desde el alto el fuego de octubre de 2025, mientras que Israel afirma que cuatro de sus soldados han sido asesinados por militantes en Gaza durante el mismo periodo.
(1 dólar = 3,0991 shekels)

items.title: Trump administration cannot overhaul fair housing grant program, appeals court rules
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: A federal appeals court on Monday refused to allow President Donald Trump's administration to redirect money away from over 100 non-profit organizations that had historically received funding to help prevent and investigate housing discrimination.
items.body:
A federal appeals court on Monday refused to allow President Donald Trump's administration to redirect money away from over 100 non-profit organizations that had historically received funding to help prevent and investigate housing discrimination.
The Boston-based 1st US Circuit Court of Appeals largely rejected the administration's request to lift an order by a lower-court judge who had blocked the US Department of Housing and Urban Development from implementing sweeping changes to a decades-old grant program designed to combat housing discrimination.
Boston-based US District Judge Myong Joun had [USN:L1N44N107 TEXT:"sided in August "]with the National Fair Housing Alliance and the Massachusetts Fair Housing Center, which sued in July to block what they said was the latest effort by HUD under Trump to roll back fair housing enforcement.
A three-judge 1st Circuit panel comprised only of appointees of Democratic presidents said the Trump administration had failed to demonstrate it was likely to succeed in finding that Joun exceeded his authority by issuing that decision.
The court declined to put most of Joun's decision on hold while the government pursues its appeal. It agreed to lift one part requiring HUD to issue new notices of funding opportunities for fiscal year 2025 that would require grants to be awarded under the 2024 system.
Joun imposed that condition at a time when the funding was rapidly set to expire on September 30. But the administration said that after he ruled, the basis for that part of Joun's decision was eliminated when Congress through a funding measure effectively extended the expiration date to September 30, 2027.
HUD and lawyers for the plaintiffs did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The case centers on the Fair Housing Initiatives Program, which Congress created in 1987 and that has long provided multi-year grants for fair housing organizations to help enforce the Fair Housing Act.
In the past, HUD would typically award over 100 grants ranging from $75,000 to $425,000, according to lawyers for the fair housing groups. That funding supported a network of organizations that assist people claiming they experienced housing discrimination.
In July, HUD moved to overhaul that system by announcing it would not allocate any of its congressionally appropriated funding for the 2025 fiscal year to private enforcement initiatives or to multi-year grants issued through the Fair Housing Initiatives Program.
HUD instead planned to use $46 million of the $56 million that Congress had appropriated for just five grants, $25 million of which would go to a law school. The remaining $10 million could go to a state or local agency.
The Trump administration also sought to force grant recipients to sign onto unrelated conditions to receive funding, by imposing requirements that they not use any funding to support "gender ideology" or "illegal immigration."
Joun, an appointee of Democratic President Joe Biden, said HUD failed to provide a reasoned explanation or rely on relevant data in crafting the restructuring, which "effectively bars the very housing organizations that have been effectuating FHIP's mission year after year since its enactment."
The Trump administration swiftly appealed, contending HUD had discretion to decide how to allocate the funds and that the judge "had no basis whatsoever to dictate how HUD should disburse the funds in question."
"The orders micromanage HUD’s administration of a national program and prevent HUD from exercising the discretion that Congress gave it," the US Department of Justice argued on the administration's behalf.
Massachusetts Fair Housing Center, et al v. Department of Housing and Urban Development, et al, 1st Circuit, No. 26-2084.
For the plaintiffs: Lila Miller of Relman Colfax
For HUD: Sarah Clark Griffin of the US Department of Justice
Read more:
[USN:L1N44N107 TEXT:"US judge blocks Trump overhaul of funding for fair housing groups"]

items.title: Top hyperscalers likely to have more AI-linked debt than now known, S&P Global warns
items.author: Marc Jones
items.creator: Marc Jones
items.summary: S&P Global estimates the world's biggest tech firms are likely to have more AI-linked liabilities than currently known, although its top analyst for the sector sees no need to change any ratings at present.
items.body:
S&P Global estimates the world's biggest tech firms are likely to have more AI-linked liabilities than currently known, although its top analyst for the sector sees no need to change any ratings at present.
Debt issued by AI infrastructure providers and so-called 'neocloud' firms such as Nvidia-backed CoreWeave has sunk to [USN:L4N461208 TEXT:"increasingly stressed levels"] in recent weeks amid concerns about the aggressive scale of their borrowing.
S&P's Global Head for Digital Infrastructure Mark Habib said the biggest risk to hyperscalers' ratings remained whether expected profits fail to materialise.
But he also highlighted so-called 'interconnected financing structures', where hyperscalers effectively guarantee huge data centre builds, or smaller AI companies.
"It is safe to assume that there is more (debt) out there that we are not seeing," Habib said during a roundtable in London.
"If it's not reported, then it's not part of the disclosure by the hyperscalers. Also, if we are not rating the transactions where this liability may accrue, then the fact of the matter is that we might not have the visibility."
S&P expects the top six US hyperscalers — Amazon (AMZN.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Oracle (ORCL.N) , Meta (META.O) , and SpaceX (SPCX.O) — to spend more than $7 trillion on data centers and other AI-related capex between 2025 and 2030, and have negative free cash flow until at least next year.
Habib said there wasn't an estimate of how much additional debt the circular financing might add to firms' balance sheets, although he said S&P was trying to take a "holistic" view overall.
Back in July, it downgraded Oracle to BBB-, the lowest rung of 'investment grade', on concerns about its AI spending and what it called "an uncertain path to profitability".
Habib was also asked whether the recent market selloff of bonds linked to the aggressive AI buildout was a sign that investors see them as riskier than ratings indicate.
"For now, we don't have the view that there is a major disconnect that needs to force our ratings to change at this point," he said, saying S&P's scores were designed to take a longer-term view.
He said what could change that view was if it became clear the amount of money being spent was no longer sustainable.
"And that could come from a variety of drivers," Habib said. "Further increases in the investments (by AI firms), or a view that the revenue rate of competition is getting too intense."

items.title: Solvay cuts 2026 forecast after Middle East conflict hits third quarter
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Solvay cut its 2026 forecast after the Middle East conflict and a peroxide plant shutdown at Sadara in Saudi Arabia hit third-quarter earnings.
items.body:
Solvay (SOLB.BR) cut its 2026 forecast after the Middle East conflict and a peroxide plant shutdown at Sadara in Saudi Arabia hit third-quarter earnings.
The chemicals group now sees full-year EBITDA of €720 million to €740 million, slightly below the company-compiled consensus of €775 million, and free cash flow of between €120 million and €150 million.
• Solvay previously forecast 2026 underlying EBITDA of €770 million to €850 million and free cash flow of at least €200 million
• The group posted preliminary third-quarter underlying EBITDA of €173 million, missing consensus by 7%, and sales in line at €1.03 billion
• It said the Middle East conflict reduced quarterly underlying EBITDA by about €25 million, including nearly €15 million linked to the shutdown of the peroxide plant at the Sadara complex in Saudi Arabia
• Solvay said it was pursuing options to limit the shutdown's financial impact, citing joint-venture contractual provisions that could allow it to recover lost profit
($1 = 0.8921 euros)

"And that could come from a variety of drivers," Habib said. "Further increases in the investments (by AI firms), or a view that the revenue rate of competition is getting too intense."

Source: Reuters

LONDON, Oct 19 : S&P Global estimates the world's biggest tech firms are likely to have more AI-linked liabilities than currently known, although its top analyst for the sector sees no need to change any ratings at present.
Debt issued by AI infrastructure providers and so-called 'neocloud' firms such as Nvidia-backed CoreWeave has sunk to increasingly stressed levels in recent weeks amid concerns about the aggressive scale of their borrowing.
S&P's Global Head for Digital Infrastructure Mark Habib said the biggest risk to hyperscalers' ratings remained whether expected profits fail to materialise.
But he also highlighted so-called 'interconnected financing structures', where hyperscalers effectively guarantee huge data centre builds, or smaller AI companies.

"It is safe to assume that there is more (debt) out there that we are not seeing," Habib said during a roundtable in London.
"If it's not reported, then it's not part of the disclosure by the hyperscalers. Also, if we are not rating the transactions where this liability may accrue, then the fact of the matter is that we might not have the visibility."
S&P expects the top six US hyperscalers — Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Oracle, Meta, and SpaceX — to spend more than $7 trillion on data centers and other AI-related capex between 2025 and 2030, and have negative free cash flow until at least next year.
Habib said there wasn't an estimate of how much additional debt the circular financing might add to firms' balance sheets, although he said S&P was trying to take a "holistic" view overall.
Back in July, it downgraded Oracle to BBB-, the lowest rung of 'investment grade', on concerns about its AI spending and what it called "an uncertain path to profitability".
Habib was also asked whether the recent market selloff of bonds linked to the aggressive AI buildout was a sign that investors see them as riskier than ratings indicate.
"For now, we don't have the view that there is a major disconnect that needs to force our ratings to change at this point," he said, saying S&P's scores were designed to take a longer-term view.
He said what could change that view was if it became clear the amount of money being spent was no longer sustainable.
"And that could come from a variety of drivers," Habib said. "Further increases in the investments (by AI firms), or a view that the revenue rate of competition is getting too intense."

items.title: Unilever to sell Welly bandage brand to Forward Consumer Partners
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Unilever on Monday said it has agreed to sell Welly Health PBC to private-equity firm Forward Consumer Partners, but did not disclose financial terms of the sale.
items.body:
Unilever (ULVR.L) on Monday said it has agreed to sell Welly Health PBC to private-equity firm Forward Consumer Partners, but did not disclose financial terms of the sale.
The consumer products giant had acquired a majority stake in the US brand, known for its colorful adhesive bandages, in 2021 from Welly co-founder Eric Ryan for an undisclosed price.
The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter, subject to customary closing conditions
Forward Consumer Partners is expected to bring back Ryan as a strategic adviser and board member, the Wall Street Journal, which first reported the story, said
Unilever, the maker of Knorr stock cubes and Hellmann's mayonnaise, has been shifting towards beauty and well-being brands under CEO Fernando Fernandez
Forward Consumer Partners did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment

items.title: Tennis Elina Svitolina annonce se séparer de Gaël Monfils, invoquant les conséquences de la guerre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Elina Svitolina, sixième joueuse mondiale de tennis, a annoncé lundi se séparer du Français Gaël Monfils, ancien numéro six mondial du circuit ATP, l'Ukrainienne précisant que le poids émotionnel de la guerre menée par la Russie contre son pays natal l'avait amenée à ressentir le besoin de se redécouvrir.
items.body:
Elina Svitolina, sixième joueuse mondiale de tennis, a annoncé lundi se séparer du Français Gaël Monfils, ancien numéro six mondial du circuit ATP, l'Ukrainienne précisant que le poids émotionnel de la guerre menée par la Russie contre son pays natal l'avait amenée à ressentir le besoin de se redécouvrir.
Le couple s'était marié en juillet 2021 et leur fille avait Skai est née en octobre 2022.
Annonçant cette séparation dans un post Instagram, Elina Svitolina a décrit les difficultés personnelles auxquelles elle a été confrontée depuis l'invasion de l(Ukraine par la Russie en février 2022.
"C'est la chose la plus difficile que j’aie jamais eu à partager. Tout le monde sait à quel point l’Ukraine compte pour moi. Ce dont j’ai rarement parlé, c’est de ce que la guerre m’a fait vivre intérieurement".
"L'année dernière, je vous avais dit que je devais m’éloigner des courts parce que je n’étais pas dans le bon état d’esprit. Aujourd’hui, je souhaite m’ouvrir un peu davantage. Ce que vous n’avez pas vu, ce sont les nuits blanches, les doutes et le sentiment de me perdre peu à peu".
"Gaël a tout vu. Il n’a jamais lâché ma main. Nous nous sommes battus ensemble pendant longtemps, de toutes nos forces. Mais certaines batailles se livrent au plus profond de soi, et aucun amour, aussi grand soit-il, ne peut les remporter à votre place."
Elina Svitolina, 32 ans, a demandé de la bienveillance et le respect de sa vie privée alors que sa famille traverse cette séparation, soulignant que personne n'était à blâmer.
"Avec le temps, j’ai fini par comprendre que je devais retrouver le chemin vers moi-même et que je ne pouvais pas y parvenir au sein de notre mariage", a-t-elle ajouté.
"C’est la vérité la plus difficile à laquelle j’ai jamais dû faire face et la chose la plus difficile que j’ai jamais dû dire à la personne que j’aime."
"Gaël m’a écoutée. Il a respecté mes besoins avec une force et une dignité que je n’oublierai jamais. Gaël m’a aimée dans mes plus grandes joies comme dans mes moments les plus sombres, et je l’ai aimé de tout mon cœur".
"Skai passera toujours en premier. Notre mariage prend fin, mais pas notre famille. Nous serons toujours ses parents, côte à côte, à chaque étape de sa vie".
Sur le court, Elina Svitolina, quadruple demi-finaliste de Grand Chelem, s’est récemment qualifiée pour les finales WTA de fin de saison à Indian Wells, en Californie.
Le Français Gael Monfils, 40 ans, l’un des joueurs les plus charismatiques de sa génération, a [USN:L6N3VI0EM TEXT:"pris sa retraite du tennis professionnel"], selon l’Agence internationale pour l’intégrité du tennis (ITIA).
Il prévoyait de prendre sa retraite fin 2026 et de faire ses adieux lors du Masters de Paris en novembre, mais l’ITIA le répertorie désormais comme retraité.

items.title: Brazil detects Newcastle disease at turkey farm in southern state
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazil has detected a case of Newcastle disease at a turkey farm in the southern state of Santa Catarina, Agriculture Minister Andre de Paula said on Monday, adding that sanitary measures had been put in place and would affect 133 farms in the region.
items.body:
Brazil has detected a case of Newcastle disease at a turkey farm in the southern state of Santa Catarina, Agriculture Minister Andre de Paula said on Monday, adding that sanitary measures had been put in place and would affect 133 farms in the region.
Newcastle is a highly contagious and viral disease affecting birds, like avian flu
Brazil is the world's largest chicken meat exporter
Brazilian officials said they were preparing detailed reports and would share all relevant information with the country's main trading partners
Brazil's Acting Secretary for Agricultural Trade, Rafael Requiao, said it was too early to provide any concrete information on possible import suspensions
China, one of Brazil's main chicken export destinations, in 2024 [USN:L1N3YL0U4 TEXT:"imposed an embargo"] on chicken meat from Rio Grande do Sul after a case of Newcastle disease was confirmed at a commercial farm in the state
