items.title: Trump creará nueva división de Institutos Nacionales de Salud y grupo de trabajo para salud de la mujer
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, firmará este lunes, junto a la primera dama, Melania Trump, un decreto presidencial mediante el cual se creará un grupo de trabajo y una división de los Institutos Nacionales de Salud (NIH, por sus siglas en inglés) dedicada a la salud de la mujer, según ha informado la Casa Blanca.
items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, firmará este lunes, junto a la primera dama, Melania Trump, un decreto presidencial mediante el cual se creará un grupo de trabajo y una división de los Institutos Nacionales de Salud (NIH, por sus siglas en inglés) dedicada a la salud de la mujer, según ha informado la Casa Blanca.
El grupo de trabajo estará dirigido por la jefa de gabinete de Trump en la Casa Blanca, Susie Wiles —quien anunció recientemente que ya no padece cáncer— y por el secretario de Salud, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., según dijo un funcionario de la Casa Blanca.
La nueva División de Salud de la Mujer de los NIH no sustituirá a la Oficina de Investigación sobre la Salud de la Mujer de la agencia, sino que tendrá un mandato más amplio que irá más allá de la investigación.
"El presidente Donald J. Trump y la primera dama Melania Trump firmarán un decreto ejecutivo por el que se crea una División de Salud de la Mujer en los NIH y un Grupo de Trabajo de la Casa Blanca sobre la Salud de la Mujer, con el objetivo de subsanar las lagunas en la investigación y modernizar la atención sanitaria para las mujeres", indicó una publicación en la red social X en la que se anunció la firma.
No fue posible contactar de inmediato con representantes del Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos, que supervisa los NIH, para recabar sus comentarios. La noticia de la orden la publicó por primera vez USA Today.
En el discurso previsto para el acto, se espera que Melania Trump aborde la necesidad de utilizar la inteligencia artificial para acelerar los avances en materia de salud de la mujer, así como el acceso a la atención sanitaria y su asequibilidad, según indicó el funcionario.
Trump y su administración han impulsado recortes en salud, incluso en los NIH, y el año pasado tomaron medidas para reducir la plantilla sanitaria federal.
Durante el segundo mandato de Trump, su administración intentó recortar las subvenciones de los NIH destinadas a la investigación sobre asuntos relacionados con la diversidad y, según se informa, está tomando medidas para permitir que los cargos políticos controlen la financiación de la investigación sanitaria.

items.title: France in turmoil: What might follow a weekend of riots?
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: France saw some of the worst unrest in years at the weekend as huge protests across the country over the cost of living and underfunded public services descended into riots and looting.
items.body:
France saw some of the worst [USN:L1N46401W TEXT:"unrest in years"] at the weekend as huge protests across the country over the cost of living and underfunded public services descended into riots and looting.
Limoges town hall was torched and more than 3,000 shops were pillaged or damaged, according to the government, as violent groups clashed with police in cities across the country.
While mayors of France's biggest cities [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"demanded answers"] from the government on Monday over what they say was a lack of preparation, authorities rushed to set up support measures for impacted businesses and bolster security as calm returned to the streets.
Here is the latest on the situation in France:
WHAT WILL THE GOVERNMENT DO TO QUELL THE VIOLENCE, COMPENSATE VICTIMS? Some 2,400 people were arrested during the weekend and police investigators are poring over online videos and images to track down looters. [USN:L8N4650PE TEXT:"Partial curfews"] are being organised in some municipalities while the government has said it will increase police numbers on the ground, especially for next weekend if it sees renewed protests. It has not specified how many extra officers will be made available.
For businesses and victims of the violence, the government is putting in place state-financed furlough measures to help employers avoid layoffs, and funds are being set aside to help companies meet their immediate cashflow needs. The government has yet to provide full details of the funding or how the money will be distributed. Insurers are also expected to cover some of the damage.
HOW WILL THE GOVERNMENT ADDRESS COMPLAINTS ABOUT THE COST OF LIVING AND PUBLIC SERVICES? France's extremely strained public finances mean the government has precious little room for broader measures to address protesters' anger over the rising cost of living.
It has already hiked emergency spending this year to help certain sectors like farmers, fishermen and haulers cope with high fuel costs caused by the Iran war .
The protests in France [USN:L1N45S0C7 TEXT:"began last month at high schools"] in Paris' working-class northern suburbs, where anger over teacher shortages and shabby facilities evolved into a broader movement.
The government has so far not committed to a substantial increase in funding for schools. However, it [USN:L6N45V0FM TEXT:"has pledged"] to send some 3,000 teachers, who are fully qualified but have not yet started work, to fill staffing gaps.
WILL PROTESTS ESCALATE OR HAVE THEY PEAKED? Some protesters have already called for a new round of demonstrations on Saturday, October 24. Unions have called for strikes on November 5 to protest budget cuts and support hiking wages.
The weekend violence has largely eclipsed the recent high school student protests. Schools are now on a break for two weeks, but there have been reports of protests at some universities.
HOW WILL THE CRISIS AFFECT FRANCE'S DIRE ECONOMIC SITUATION? The unrest will likely deal a blow to business confidence, which is already fragile due to a fiscal crisis and high energy prices resulting from the Iran war.
The minority government is struggling to pass spending cuts in France's deeply divided parliament as part of its 2027 budget and is at risk of being toppled by opposition parties if a compromise cannot be found with at least some of them.
The unrest has weighed on French stocks and the euro and put pressure on [USN:L1N465097 TEXT:"French government bonds"], pushing the risk premium over the 10-year German benchmark up to 146 basis points, the highest in two weeks.
WILL THE UNREST SPREAD TO OTHER COUNTRIES? If France cannot contain the unrest, there is a risk that it could spill across its borders. In neighbouring Italy, [USN:L8N46407Z TEXT:"clashes erupted"] between police and protesters on Sunday during demonstrations over poor public services and the rising cost of living.
Albania has also seen a series of student demonstrations in recent days over corruption, a lack of jobs and poor education standards while Spain and Portugal have faced protests over housing.
HOW WILL THE UNREST AFFECT THE 2027 PRESIDENTIAL ELECTION? Elections next year will see President Emmanuel Macron step down after a decade in power. The unrest is likely to give a boost to far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen, who is already the frontrunner in polls to replace him and has long talked tough on law and order.
"Le Pen no longer needs to spend any money to campaign," Jean-Baptiste Moreau, a former lawmaker from Macron's camp, [USN:L6N4650JF TEXT:"told Reuters"]. "It's not just a clear path ahead of her, it's a six-lane highway."
Hard-left candidate Jean-Luc Melenchon has come under pressure for backing protesters' demands, criticising the government's handling and not clearly condemning the violence.
Meanwhile, Macron, who headed off to the Middle East on Monday, has emerged from the crisis further weakened. His former prime minister Edouard Philippe, now a centre-right presidential candidate, said on X he wanted "decisions and initiatives" from the lame-duck leader to "restore order".
ARE PARIS AND OTHER CITIES SAFE TO VISIT? There have been no reports of any injuries to foreigners caught up in the unrest. However, several European governments [USN:L8N4650JR TEXT:"advised citizens"] travelling to France to avoid large crowds and exercise caution.
items.raw_description: France saw some of the worst unrest in years at the weekend as huge protests across the country over the cost of living and underfunded public services descended into riots and looting.

AMSTERDAM, Oct 19 : Retailer Ahold Delhaize reported a cybersecurity incident to Dutch police on Monday after it detected suspicious activity in its infrastructure, the company said, adding it took some systems offline as a precaution earlier this month.
Although only reported to the police on Monday, the incident coincided with a cyberattack in France that caused refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of stores to heat up to 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) overnight, sparking fires and spoiling food.
The Dutch National Cyber Security Centre said there was no reason to believe the incident in the Netherlands was directly linked to any cyberattacks in other countries.
Delhaize said its investigations found the suspicious activity had resulted from the "malicious actions of others", without specifying who might be responsible.

"Taking systems offline to help protect them was a precautionary measure that affected most of our brands across Europe and the United States. The investigation to date confirms this was the right decision", President and CEO Frans Muller said.
NO ONLINE ORDERS BEFORE THURSDAY
Earlier on Monday, Ahold Delhaize's Albert Heijn, the Netherlands' largest supermarket chain, said it would not resume online deliveries before Thursday at the earliest, extending to at least 11 days an outage caused by the cybersecurity incident.
Online accounts for about 10 per cent of Albert Heijn sales.
While Albert Heijn's website was back online on Monday, the websites of Ahold Delhaize’s US chains remained offline, a week after the cyber incident forced the company to shut down some of its IT systems. Ahold Delhaize said it expected e-commerce services at its US brands to resume "in the coming days".
The US brands, which include Stop & Shop, Giant Food, Hannaford and Food Lion, collectively rank among the country’s largest food retailers. Deliveries at Belgian chain Delhaize resumed over the weekend.
Ahold Delhaize previously said that there was no evidence that any customer data had been stolen.
Physical stores of several chains have remained open, but have struggled with supplies as distribution channels were also affected.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Paul Mackenzie, the Kenyan preacher who led hundreds to starve to death
items.author: Ammu Kannampilly
items.creator: Ammu Kannampilly
items.summary: More than three years after Kenyan police unearthed mass graves linked to a starvation cult led by evangelist Paul Mackenzie, the preacher was convicted of murder for the deaths of 190 children and one adult.
items.body:
More than three years after Kenyan police [USN:L8N3TR154 TEXT:"unearthed mass graves"] linked to a starvation cult led by evangelist Paul Mackenzie, the preacher was [USN:L8N4651FW TEXT:"convicted of murder"] for the deaths of 190 children and one adult.
Mackenzie's case has gripped the East African nation since officers found human remains in a forest near the Indian Ocean town of Malindi in April 2023, kicking off an investigation that would eventually unearth over 400 bodies, nearly half of them children.
The former taxi driver founded the Good News International Church in 2003, preaching increasingly apocalyptic sermons and [USN:L8N3UL0KV TEXT:"urging his followers to starve themselves"] and their children to death so they could go to heaven before the world ended.
In a March 2023 YouTube video, Mackenzie — who had thousands of followers in person and online — said that he was guided by "the voice of Christ" when he preached messages about the world coming to an end that year.
"I followed the voice that told me I had finished the work," he said.
PRESIDENT HAS SAID DEATHS SHOULD HAVE BEEN PREVENTED Videos of the preacher show him dressed in nondescript clothing, speaking calmly to hundreds of people as he recounted his experiences as an exorcist and his victory over "demonic" spirits.
Mackenzie denied charges of murder, manslaughter, child torture and terrorism in a case that highlighted the failings of Kenyan authorities and the lack of oversight governing churches in the predominantly Christian country.
The Kenya National Commission on Human Rights, an independent body, said it was deplorable that Mackenzie could have been first arrested in 2017 and charged with radicalisation but continued to operate for years.
"This points to a failure in the investigation and prosecution processes. The arrest should have triggered investigations that would have saved the lives of several people," the KNCHR said in a 2024 report.
Kenyan President William Ruto has said that government agencies should have been able to prevent the deaths, adding that he took responsibility as president.
DOZENS OF CHILDREN FOUND LIVING IN COMPOUND Mackenzie grew up in Kwale, a rural county in southeast Kenya, and moved to Malindi in the early 1990s to work as a taxi driver.
There, he became increasingly focused on religion, Japheth Charo, who worked as a driver alongside him, told Reuters in 2023.
"He started attacking other faiths like Muslims and Catholics. His preaching started becoming extreme," said Charo, whose family had joined Mackenzie's church but left after his sermons started to alarm them.
In 2012, Mackenzie registered a TV company called Good News Media and he broadcast sermons on a YouTube channel that had 7,000 subscribers, KNCHR wrote in a report on the case.
Police searched Mackenzie's Malindi compound in 2017 and found dozens of children living there without attending school. He was charged with offering education at an unregistered facility but continued his teachings until 2019, when his church was shut down and he relocated to the Shakahola Forest.
People were lured there by the promise of affordable arable land but found armed militia who enforced the fasting and eventual deaths of followers, KNCHR found. Those who defied orders to fast or tried to escape were strangled or clubbed to death, it added.
STARVE THEMSELVES BEFORE THE WORLD'S END Mackenzie, believed to be in his early 50s, is a domineering figure who forced his followers to cut themselves off from society, forbidding them from engaging with schools or hospitals, institutions he branded as satanic, relatives of victims said.
"He told them to starve themselves ahead of the world's end on April 15, saying he would be the last one and that he would lock the doors," Stephen Mwiti, whose wife and six children were among the fatalities, told Reuters in 2023.
Mackenzie's grip on his followers continued even after the graves in Shakahola were exposed. Prosecutors charged him in connection with the deaths of 52 other people after bodies were exhumed last year in Kwa Binzaro village, some 30 km (18 miles) from Shakahola.
They said he masterminded and oversaw the offences at Kwa Binzaro while in detention, using radical teachings to draw victims to the remote site. Mackenzie has pleaded not guilty in that case.
items.raw_description: More than three years after Kenyan police unearthed mass graves linked to a starvation cult led by evangelist Paul Mackenzie, the preacher was convicted of murder for the deaths of 190 children and one adult.

items.summary: A tenista número seis do mundo, Elina Svitolina, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que ela e o ex-tenista Gael Monfils estavam encerrando seu casamento, e a ucraniana acrescentou que o impacto emocional da guerra da Rússia em seu país a levou a sentir a necessidade de se redescobrir.
items.body:
A tenista número seis do mundo, Elina Svitolina, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que ela e o ex-tenista Gael Monfils estavam encerrando seu casamento, e a ucraniana acrescentou que o impacto emocional da guerra da Rússia em seu país a levou a sentir a necessidade de se redescobrir.
Eles se casaram em julho de 2021 e tiveram uma filha, Skai, em outubro de 2022.
Ao anunciar a separação em uma postagem no Instagram, Svitolina descreveu as dificuldades pessoais que vem enfrentando desde a invasão russa à Ucrânia em 2022 e o impacto que elas tiveram em sua vida fora das quadras de tênis.
“Esta é a coisa mais difícil que já tive que compartilhar”, escreveu Svitolina. “Todos sabem o quanto a Ucrânia significa para mim. O que raramente falei é o que a guerra causou em mim por dentro."
“No ano passado, eu disse a vocês que precisava me afastar das quadras porque não estava no estado emocional adequado. Hoje, quero me abrir um pouco mais. O que vocês não viram foram as noites sem dormir, as dúvidas e a sensação de estar me perdendo aos poucos."
“Gael viu tudo isso. Ele nunca soltou minha mão. Lutamos juntos contra isso por muito tempo, com tudo o que tínhamos. Mas algumas batalhas acontecem bem no fundo de você, e nenhum amor vindo de outra pessoa pode vencê-las por você”, completou.
Svitolina pediu compreensão e respeito pela privacidade enquanto a família lida com a separação, ressaltando que não há ninguém a quem culpar.
“Com o tempo, passei a entender que preciso reencontrar a mim mesma e que não posso fazer isso dentro do nosso casamento”, acrescentou a semifinalista de 32 anos do Aberto da Austrália.
“É a verdade mais difícil que já tive de encarar e a coisa mais difícil que já tive de dizer à pessoa que amo."
O francês Monfils, de 40 anos, ex-número seis do mundo e um dos jogadores mais carismáticos de sua geração, se aposentou do tênis profissional, de acordo com a Agência Internacional de Integridade do Tênis (ITIA).
Ele planejava se aposentar no final de 2026 e se despedir no Masters de Paris, em novembro, mas a ITIA agora o lista como aposentado.

items.title: EEUU dice inmigrantes de Ucrania y Sudán pueden conservar su estatus de protección por el momento
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los inmigrantes procedentes de Ucrania y Sudán podrán mantener su estatus de protección temporal en Estados Unidos por el momento, informó el lunes el Departamento de Seguridad Nacional, el mismo día en que estaba previsto que expiraran dichas protecciones.
items.body:
Los inmigrantes procedentes de Ucrania y Sudán podrán mantener su estatus de protección temporal en Estados Unidos por el momento, informó el lunes el Departamento de Seguridad Nacional, el mismo día en que estaba previsto que expiraran dichas protecciones.
En un comunicado, un portavoz del DHS afirmó que los anuncios relativos a los titulares de TPS de Ucrania y Sudán "se harían en el momento oportuno" y que sus protecciones en materia de inmigración seguirían vigentes.
El estatus de protección temporal permite a las personas que ya se encuentran en Estados Unidos permanecer en el país y trabajar legalmente si sus países de origen se ven afectados por desastres naturales, conflictos armados u otras circunstancias extraordinarias.
Esta prórroga temporal es la segunda en otros tantos meses para determinados inmigrantes acogidos al programa del TPS, a pesar de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ha tomado medidas para expulsar a otros ciudadanos extranjeros como parte de su agresiva campaña contra la inmigración.
En septiembre, su Gobierno permitió a los beneficiarios del TPS procedentes de El Salvador conservar sus protecciones, tras haber tomado anteriormente medidas para revocarlas a haitianos, venezolanos, somalíes, yemeníes, sirios y otros.
Esta última medida se produce en un momento en que Trump ha dejado de centrarse en Ucrania en los últimos días, negándose a imponer sanciones más duras a Rusia por la guerra que dura ya cuatro años y levantando las sanciones a las exportaciones de gasóleo de Moscú.
Unos 240.000 ucranianos que huyeron del conflicto se han inscrito para obtener el estatus de TPS en Estados Unidos.
Se estima que hay 6.800 beneficiarios del TPS procedentes de Sudán, donde una guerra entre el ejército y un grupo paramilitar rival ha provocado una de las peores crisis humanitarias del mundo.

items.title: Plaza cambiaria argentina se mantiene controlada con seguimiento de banco central
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El mercado cambiario argentino operaba con una leve merma el lunes con el habitual control de la entidad monetaria local que regula la liquidez mediante compra o venta de divisas.
items.body:
El mercado cambiario argentino operaba con una leve merma el lunes con el habitual control de la entidad monetaria local que regula la liquidez mediante compra o venta de divisas.
El Banco Central (BCRA) en las últimas jornadas ha incrementado su accionar en la plaza cambiaria, donde el viernes adquirió 68 millones de dólares y acumuló un saldo semanal positivo levemente superior a los 640 millones de dólares.
Las compras de la entidad elevaron las "reservas internacionales brutas a 50.236 millones de dólares y completando un saldo semanal comprador de 642 millones de dólares, el monto más alto registrado en los últimos tres meses", expresó Wise Capital.
"La estrategia oficial responde a la urgencia de abastecer de divisas al Tesoro de cara a los compromisos de deuda con tenedores de bonos Globales agendados para el próximo 9 de enero", añadió.
En este contexto, el peso mayorista se depreciaba un 0,36% a 1.523,5 unidades por dólar para la venta.
Por su parte, el riesgo país argentino se ubicaba en 660 puntos básicos, con los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil cayendo un leve 0,2% a las 1445 GMT.
La secretaría de Finanzas, dependiente del Ministerio de Economía a cargo del Luis Caputo, anunció una conversión de títulos que se llevará a cabo el martes.
"La operación permitirá a los tenedores del bono dollar-linked con vencimiento a fines de octubre (D30O6) canjearlo por instrumentos con vencimiento a fines de noviembre, en enero de 2027 y en junio de 2027.", afirmó la consultora Max Capital.
Y añadió que "al igual que en anteriores vencimientos de instrumentos dollar-linked, el Tesoro ofrece un canje anticipado para reducir la potencial volatilidad cambiaria antes de la fijación del precio el 27 de octubre".
El Índice accionario argentino, localmente conocido como Merval, desde el 19 de octubre pasará a conocerse como MSCI Merval tras el acuerdo entre Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos (BYMA) y el proveedor global de índices MSCI.
"Como te adelantamos al anunciar la alianza estratégica entre BYMA y MSCI (...) se lanzarán los nuevos índices de Renta Variable", dijo BYMA en un comunicado.
Y agregó que entre algunas de las principales características con la que contarán los índices será un valor inicial de 100 mil pesos para ambos y una moneda de publicación que será en pesos argentinos y dólares estadounidenses.
El nuevo índice accionario, el MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) iniciaba su primera jornada de negocios en baja.

items.title: Retailer Ahold Delhaize reports cybersecurity incident to Dutch police
items.author: Charlotte Van Campenhout
items.creator: Charlotte Van Campenhout
items.summary: Retailer Ahold Delhaize reported a cybersecurity incident to Dutch police on Monday after it detected suspicious activity in its infrastructure, the company said, adding it took some systems offline as a precaution earlier this month.
items.body:
Retailer Ahold Delhaize (AD.AS) reported a [USN:L8N45Z1DC TEXT:"cybersecurity incident"] to Dutch police on Monday after it detected suspicious activity in its infrastructure, the company said, adding it took some systems offline as a precaution earlier this month.
Although only reported to the police on Monday, the incident coincided with a [USN:L8N45Y11U TEXT:"cyberattack in France"] that caused refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of stores to heat up to 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) overnight, sparking fires and spoiling food.
The Dutch National Cyber Security Centre said there was no reason to believe the incident in the Netherlands was directly linked to any cyberattacks in other countries.
Delhaize said its investigations found the suspicious activity had resulted from the "malicious actions of others", without specifying who might be responsible.
"Taking systems offline to help protect them was a precautionary measure that affected most of our brands across Europe and the United States. The investigation to date confirms this was the right decision", President and CEO Frans Muller said.
NO ONLINE ORDERS BEFORE THURSDAY Earlier on Monday, Ahold Delhaize's Albert Heijn, the Netherlands' largest supermarket chain, said it would [USN:L1N465082 TEXT:"not resume"] online deliveries before Thursday at the earliest, extending to at least 11 days an outage caused by the cybersecurity incident.
Online accounts for about 10% of Albert Heijn sales.
While Albert Heijn's website was back online on Monday, the websites of Ahold Delhaize’s US chains remained offline, a week after the cyber incident forced the company to shut down some of its IT systems. Ahold Delhaize said it expected e-commerce services at its US brands to resume "in the coming days".
The US brands, which include Stop & Shop, Giant Food, Hannaford and Food Lion, collectively rank among the country’s largest food retailers. Deliveries at Belgian chain Delhaize resumed over the weekend.
Ahold Delhaize previously said that there was no evidence that any customer data had been stolen.
Physical stores of several chains have remained open, but have struggled with supplies as distribution channels were also affected.

items.title: Apple faces new damages bid after landmark $5.7 billion patent verdict
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: A technology company that won a landmark $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict against Apple has asked a federal judge to tack on more damages and interest, potentially exposing the iPhone maker to hundreds of millions of dollars in additional liability.
items.body:
A technology company that won a landmark $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict against Apple (AAPL.O) has asked a federal judge to tack on more damages and interest, potentially exposing the iPhone maker to hundreds of millions of dollars in additional liability.
Here are the details:
A California federal jury in September awarded San Diego-based Taction the largest-ever US patent infringement award after finding Apple [USN:L6N45I048 TEXT:"violated"] its patented technology for haptic feedback in iPhones and Apple Watches
Taction in a filing on Friday said the verdict only covers Apple sales from 2021 to late March and asked the court to impose damages for the six months of sales since then
Taction also asked the judge to award prejudgment interest at California's 7% statutory rate, which would add at least hundreds of millions of dollars to the $5.7 billion verdict
“The size of the jury’s award is no reason to withhold interest,” Taction told the court. The company is also seeking post-judgment interest
Apple has denied any wrongdoing and said it will appeal. It has also [USN:L6N4600XS TEXT:"asked the court"] to overturn the verdict
Apple was ordered to pay $184.2 million in prejudgment interest to medical-monitoring technology company Masimo this month in a different intellectual property case after Masimo [USN:L6N3WF0PJ TEXT:"won a jury award"] of $634 million last year
The case is Taction Technology v. Apple Inc, US District Court for the Southern District of California, No. 3:21-cv-00812.
For Taction: Lance Yang of Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan
For Apple: Roger Denning of Fish & Richardson
Read more:
[USN:L6N4600XS TEXT:"Apple asks US court to overturn jury's landmark $5.7 billion patent verdict"]
[USN:L6N45I048 TEXT:"US jury says Apple owes record $5.7 billion in haptic technology patent case"]

items.title: Kenyan starvation cult leader convicted in deaths of nearly 200 children
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Kenyan court on Monday found starvation cult leader Paul Mackenzie and about 30 others guilty of murder over the deaths of 190 children and one adult in one of the world's worst cult-related disasters in recent history.
items.body:
A Kenyan court on Monday found starvation cult leader Paul Mackenzie and about 30 others guilty of murder over the deaths of 190 children and one adult in one of the world's worst cult-related disasters in recent history.
Mackenzie and his co-accused will be given their sentence on November 6.
He was [USN:L8N3Z51Y2 TEXT:"arrested in 2023"] after police received a tip-off, and weeks later authorities began uncovering bodies in shallow graves in the Shakahola Forest near the coast in southeastern Kenya.
Prosecutors say Mackenzie and his Good News International Church organised a Christian doomsday sect in which they ordered followers to starve themselves and their children to death to go to heaven before the world ended.
Mackenzie denied murder charges, saying he did not force the victims to starve, but the court rejected that argument.
In total, more than 400 bodies have been recovered from the Shakahola Forest. Many were severely decomposed, with only 26 bodies able to be identified.
Monday's judgment covered 191 deaths while investigations into the other deaths are ongoing.
FAMILIES IN COURT TO HEAR VERDICT Justice Diana Kavedza Mochache said in a hearing lasting more than eight hours that in some cases children were isolated and denied food while their parents watched.
Mackenzie was in court, wearing a striped polo shirt and red trousers, sitting alongside his wife who is one of the co-accused.
When his name was read out by the judge he stood silently, staring into space.
Family members of some of those who died in the forest gathered to hear the judgment at Mombasa High Court.
Francis Wanje, 62, lost eight family members including two grandchildren to the cult.
Speaking before the verdict, he told Reuters: "It has been really a heavy thing (for) us as a family, and it has really taken us very far in terms of psychological problems, ... I was hoping for this particular day."
The Shakahola tragedy has gripped Kenya since the discovery of mass graves in the coastal forest more than three years ago.
It raised questions over how Mackenzie was able to continue to operate despite having been on the radar of the authorities since 2017 when his premises were searched by police. In 2019, authorities shut down Mackenzie's church and he relocated to the Shakahola Forest, police said.
The case has also led to calls for tougher oversight of churches and other religious organisations in a country where religious faith plays a prominent role in public life.
Kenyan President William Ruto said in 2023 that government agencies should have been able to prevent the deaths. He said he took responsibility as president.
CHILDREN WERE FIRST TO STARVE People with direct knowledge of the cult's activities [USN:L8N36W0BR TEXT:"told Reuters"] that Mackenzie planned the mass starvation in three phases: first children, then women and young men, and finally the remaining men.
A former taxi driver, Mackenzie forbade cult members from sending their children to school and from going to hospital when they were ill, branding such institutions as Satanic, some of his followers told Reuters for a 2023 article.
Cult members lived in makeshift homes of polythene sheeting and thatch that Mackenzie divided into areas with biblical names like Jerusalem and Judea.
The plight of his followers began to emerge in mid-March 2023, when a local man told police that his brother and wife had starved their children to death in the forest on Mackenzie's orders.
Mackenzie was arrested but released on bail, after which relatives say he brought forward the date on which he told his followers the world would end. Police arrested him again in April 2023 and started combing through the forest more systematically and began exhuming mass graves.
Mackenzie faces other charges over the forest deaths including terrorism-related ones, which he has denied.
Prosecutors say while he was in detention he also directed the deaths of 52 people in [USN:L8N3Z51Y2 TEXT:"Kwa Binzaro village"], which lies about 30 km (18 miles) from Shakahola. Mackenzie has pleaded not guilty in that case.

items.title: Europe EV sales rose 70% in September, around 30% of market share
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Battery-electric vehicle (BEV) registrations in Europe rose 70.3% in September, as high oil prices, subsidies and the availability of more affordable models continued to lead the growth.
items.body:
Battery-electric vehicle (BEV) registrations in Europe rose 70.3% in September, as high oil prices, subsidies and the availability of more affordable models continued to lead the growth.
Around a third of cars sold across 17 key European markets in September were BEVs, data from E-Mobility Europe, New Automotive and Fier Automotive showed on Monday, amid a [USN:L6N4620KS TEXT:"deal "]made by France and Germany to soften proposed EU car emissions rules.
BEV registrations reached 300,202 vehicles in September, giving fully electric cars a 32.6% market share
1.98 million BEVs have been registered across Europe so far this year, up 38.1% from the same period in 2025
France hit a 41.7% BEV market share with 65,243 registrations, while Germany's share reached 34.6% with 88,724 registrations.
The Nordic market remained Europe's most electrified, led by Norway at 98.8% and followed by Denmark (88.8%), Finland (62.7%) and Sweden (49.0%).
BEVs accounted for around half of the registrations in Ireland, Portugal, Belgium and the Netherlands
The Czech Republic, Italy and Poland remained among Europe's least electrified markets at 11.2%, 7.6% and 6.2%, respectively.
(This story has been corrected to say that the BEV market share is around 30%, not almost, in the headline and paragraph 2.)

items.title: 中国証監会、市場安定を最優先へ　株式や債券の動向注視＝国営メディア
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [上海／北京 １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[上海／北京 １９日 ロイター] - 中国国営メディアは１９日、中国証券監督管理委員会（証監会）の呉清主席が北京で開かれた金融フォーラムで、資本市場の安定を最優先する方針を示したと報じた。株式や債券、為替市場でボラティリティーや相関性が高まっているとして、リスク評価や政策手段を強化すると表明した。

呉氏は、世界市場の関連性が強まっていることを踏まえ、証監会として国内外の市場を注視し、市場安定の仕組みを改善すると述べた。市場や部門を横断して波及するリスクに細心の注意を払う必要があると指摘。新たな業態などに伴うリスクへの備えを強化するほか、中国内の個別銘柄に連動するオフショアのレバレッジ商品に関しても警戒していくと言及した。

呉氏は、市場改革の一環として、上海証券取引所のハイテク企業向け市場「科創板（スター・マーケット）」と深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」を念頭に、テクノロジー企業の選定の仕組みを改善していくと述べた。中国の資本市場の新商品拡充策の一環として、１８のアクティブ運用型上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の登録承認についても明らかにした。

世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の売り圧力を受け、中国の主要指数ＣＳＩ３００指数は、足元では１０週連続で下落している。ハイテク株中心の「科創板」５０指数は６月下旬に付けた今年のピークから４０％近く下落し、年初来の上昇分を失った。

[１９日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアが主催する国際投資会議「フューチャー・インベストメント・イニシアチブ（ＦＩＩ）」について、同国政府は今年の対面開催を中止することを決めた。関係筋４人が明らかにした。

中東紛争の拡大に伴う一連の攻撃で国内に多数の犠牲者が出て、経済活動が混乱していることを受けた。

ＦＩＩは１０月２６日から２９日の日程で開催される予定だったが、オンライン開催に切り替えるか、延期される見通し。

世界の首脳や大企業の経営者、金融関係者が多数参加することから、ＦＩＩは世界経済フォーラム年次総会になぞらえて「砂漠のダボス会議」と呼ばれている。

サウジ政府の広報室はコメント要請にすぐには応じなかった。

Oct 19 : Remon Vos' 100-foot maxi Black Jack 100, skippered by Tristan Le Brun, won monohull line honours in the 2026 Rolex Middle Sea Race on Monday, crossing the finish line in Malta at 3:51 p.m.
The yacht’s elapsed time for the 606-nautical-mile (1,122-km) course around Sicily was two days, three hours, 51 minutes and zero seconds.
The 47th edition began on Saturday from Grand Harbour with 107 yachts and 945 sailors from 55 countries.
The race is a blast around Sicily, starting and finishing in Malta’s Grand Harbour.

items.title: 米住宅建設業者指数、10月は約14年半ぶり低水準　ローン金利・建材高が重し
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 全米住宅建設業協会（ＮＡＨＢ）が１９日発表した１０月のＮＡＨＢ／ウェルズ・ファーゴ住宅建設業者指数は２９と、前月の３２から低下し、２０１２年６月以来、約１４年半ぶりの低水準となった。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は３１への低下だった。

中東紛争により住宅ローン金利とエネルギー関連の建材価格が上昇しているほか、移民取り締まりに伴う人手不足や、関税措置によるコスト上昇が影響している。

住宅ローン金利はここ数週間で急上昇しており、住宅金融公社フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローン金利は先週、７．４０％と約３年ぶりの高水準となった。米国とイスラエルの対イラン戦争がインフレをあおる中、米国債利回りに連動して借り入れコストが上昇し、住宅販売を圧迫している。

ＮＡＨＢのビル・オーウェンズ会長は「住宅建設業者は、建設ローンや建築建材、ディーゼル燃料のコスト上昇に加え、慢性的な人手不足にも直面している」と指摘。「全米で建設業者の３分の１超が、過去１カ月間に自社の事業地域で移民取り締まりの動きがあったと報告しており、これが建設の遅れや、合法的な労働者が出勤を躊躇（ちゅうちょ）する事態を招いている」と述べた。

買い手を呼び込むために値下げを実施した建設業者は４３％と、２０─２６年の期間で最も高い割合となった。平均値下げ幅は６％と横ばいだった。販売促進策の実施率は６５％。１９カ月連続で６０％以上となっている。 

現在の販売状況を示す指数は２ポイント低下の３３。販売見通しを示す指数は５ポイント低下の３２となった。

見込み客の来場状況を示す指数は５ポイント低下の１８。ＮＡＨＢのチーフエコノミスト、ロバート・ディーツ氏は同指数について、コロナ禍の２０年４月を除くと、１２年４月以来の低水準だと指摘した。

items.title: ホルムズ不安定化「米に責任」、外国勢力伴わぬ安保必要＝イラン外相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１９日 ロイター] - イランのアラグチ外相は１９日、ロシアのラブロフ外相との共同記者会見で、ホルムズ海峡の不安定化と緊張の高まりは米国に責任があるとの認識を示し、地域問題は外交を通じて解決されなければならないと述べた。

アラグチ氏は「外国勢力の駐留を伴わず、地域内部から安全保障を実現するあらゆる取り組みを歓迎する。それが正しい方向性だと考えている」と述べ、地域諸国に対し共同の安全保障体制の構築に向けて取り組むよう呼びかけた。

ロシアのラブロフ外相はアラグチ氏との会談で、ロシアはエネルギー価格の大幅な変動に利益を見いだしていないとし、ロシアは長期的な視点で経済と国家の発展を計画する必要があると述べた。

items.title: US says immigrants from Ukraine, Sudan can keep protected status for now
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Immigrants from Ukraine and Sudan can keep their temporary protected status in the United States for now, the Department of Homeland Security said on Monday, the day protections had been set to expire.
items.body:
Immigrants from Ukraine and Sudan can keep their temporary protected status in the United States for now, the Department of Homeland Security said on Monday, the day protections had been set to expire.
In a statement, a DHS spokesperson said that announcements on Ukrainian and Sudanese TPS holders would "be made at the appropriate time" and that their immigration protections would remain in place.
[USN:L6N3RN0SH TEXT:"Temporary protected status"] allows people already in the US to stay in the country and work legally if their home countries are affected by natural disasters, armed conflict or other extraordinary conditions.
The temporary respite is the second in as many months for certain immigrants under the TPS program, even as US President Donald Trump has moved to expel other foreign nationals as part of an aggressive immigration crackdown.
In September, his administration allowed TPS holders from [USN:L1N45117M TEXT:"El Salvador"] to retain their protections after earlier moving to revoke them from Haitians, Venezuelans, Somalis, Yemenis, Syrians and others.
The latest allowance comes as Trump has pivoted away from Ukraine in recent days, [USN:L1N463009 TEXT:"declining to impose"] tougher sanctions on Russia over the four-year-old war and lifting sanctions on Moscow's diesel exports.
Some [USN:L6N3PN0MX TEXT:"240,000 Ukrainians"] who fled the conflict have registered for TPS status in the United States.
There are an estimated 6,800 TPS holders from Sudan, where a war between the army and a rival paramilitary has created one of the world's [USN:L6N45M0KU TEXT:"worst humanitarian crises"].
Global Refuge, a faith-based refugee-focused nonprofit group, welcomed the respite for Ukrainians and Sudanese enrolled in TPS but urged an official decision to give enrollees, their dependents and employers certainty.
"The appropriate time to act was weeks ago. Families who depend on this status to stay safe and keep working deserve a formal decision in writing," Krish O'Mara Vignarajah, president and CEO of the group, said in a statement.

items.title: Goldman Sachs advierte sobre riesgos en Wall Street y revela 23 acciones para protegerse
items.author: Carlos Rodríguez Salcedo
items.summary: La firma estadounidense seleccionó acciones de salud y consumo básico con menor volatilidad y elevados flujos de caja, mientras advierte sobre los riesgos que enfrenta el mercado bursátil.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Goldman Sachs ( GS ) advirtió sobre nuevos riesgos para Wall Street ante la desaceleración del crecimiento económico, el encarecimiento del financiamiento y una concentración bursátil que amenaza con provocar correcciones en las acciones que han liderado las ganancias. Ver más: De Cemex a Walmex: qué esperar de los reportes trimestrales en la Bolsa mexicana El banco estadounidense considera que el mercado accionario todavía tiene margen para avanzar, pero recomienda prestar mayor atención a las compañías defensivas y a las empresas rezagadas que podrían beneficiarse de una recuperación del consumo. El equipo de analistas liderado Ben Snider identificó señales de vulnerabilidad en el S&P 500. Los especialistas advirtieron que “una amplitud de mercado extremadamente estrecha sugiere que los inversionistas deberían desconfiar del riesgo del factor momentum en la actualidad”, ante la posibilidad de una reversión de las acciones con mejor desempeño. La principal preocupación del banco es la distancia entre el comportamiento del S&P 500 y el de sus componentes. Mientras el índice permanece apenas un 2% por debajo de su máximo histórico, la acción mediana se encuentra un 15% por debajo de su propio récord. Esta divergencia sitúa la amplitud del mercado cerca de sus niveles más estrechos desde la burbuja puntocom . Además, las diez mayores compañías concentran aproximadamente el 40% de la capitalización del índice, frente al 37% de sus ganancias. El equipo de Snider sostiene que “las acciones deberían continuar subiendo mientras las ganancias continúen creciendo”, aunque sus previsiones apuntan a una moderación de las utilidades empresariales durante 2027. Goldman Sachs proyecta que las ganancias por acción del S&P 500 aumentarán un 36% en 2026 y un 11% en 2027. Tras ajustar distorsiones contables extraordinarias, las tasas de crecimiento serían del 29% y el 18%, respectivamente. → Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. La inteligencia artificial constituye otro factor de riesgo. Las inversiones de capital relacionadas con esta tecnología explican actualmente cerca de la mitad del crecimiento de las ganancias del índice, una contribución que disminuiría durante 2027. Las mayores tasas de interés y los precios energéticos también presionan las perspectivas. En las últimas dos semanas, la estrategia de acciones cíclicas frente a defensivas de Goldman Sachs registró una caída del 6%. A estas señales se suma una moderación de los resultados empresariales. Apenas el 53% de las compañías que habían presentado balances del tercer trimestre superó significativamente las estimaciones, frente al promedio del 64% de los cuatro trimestres anteriores. Ante el riesgo de nuevas correcciones, Goldman Sachs seleccionó 23 compañías de salud y consumo básico pertenecientes al Russell 1000, caracterizadas por su menor volatilidad, elevada generación de flujo de caja libre y perspectivas de crecimiento de ganancias. Estas son las empresas incluidas en el filtro cuantitativo del banco: Entre las seleccionadas destaca Royalty Pharma, con una valorización acumulada del 56% en 2026 y un rendimiento de flujo de caja libre del 9%. Merck registra un avance del 41%, mientras que AbbVie gana un 28%. Ver más: BCA Research cambia su apuesta por Brasil, pero descarta una terapia de choque al estilo Milei CVS Health acumula una subida del 19% y ofrece un rendimiento de flujo de caja libre del 9%. Kroger alcanza el 8%, frente al 11% de Tyson Foods, pese a que esta última registra una caída bursátil del 5% en el año. Abbott Laboratories retrocede un 14%, mientras que Colgate-Palmolive avanza un 19%. Ambas presentan rendimientos de flujo de caja libre del 5% y el 4%, respectivamente. La selección registra una mediana de volatilidad de 29, frente a 36 para el Russell 1000. Su rendimiento mediano de flujo de caja libre alcanza el 6%, comparado con el 4% del índice de referencia. Goldman Sachs excluyó empresas cuyas estimaciones de crecimiento de ganancias para 2027 fueran inferiores al 5%. La lista constituye una selección cuantitativa y no equivale a recomendaciones individuales de compra. Pese a las advertencias, Goldman Sachs mantiene su objetivo de 8.000 puntos para el cierre de 2026, equivalente a una valorización potencial del 3% frente a los 7.744 puntos utilizados como referencia. Su proyección a doce meses alcanza los 8.700 puntos, con un potencial alcista del 12%. El banco sostiene que “los rendimientos de las acciones en estos períodos han estado impulsados históricamente por el crecimiento de las ganancias y no por la expansión de las valoraciones”, pese a la desaceleración prevista para 2027. Ver más: Goldman Sachs plantea tres escenarios que definirán el precio del petróleo en 2027 Sobre el consumo estadounidense, los analistas prevén que “estos factores deberían contribuir a acelerar el crecimiento de los ingresos reales en toda la distribución de consumidores”, ante la expectativa de menores tasas de interés y precios energéticos en 2027. Una cesta de compañías de consumo discrecional orientadas a hogares de menores ingresos ya acumulaba una subida del 7% desde comienzos de octubre. La evolución de las tasas, las inversiones en inteligencia artificial y los resultados empresariales determinará si el mercado favorece una recuperación de las acciones rezagadas o mantiene la rotación hacia compañías defensivas.

items.title: 米国株式市場・午前＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック上昇、ＡＩ関連が反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　１９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１９日　ロイター］ - １９日午前の米国株式市場では、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が上昇した。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が前週の急落から反発したほか、原油価格の下落も支援材料となった。ナスダック総合指数は一時２５５．３ポイント（０．９８％）上昇した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手がけるコアウィーブは、投資判断の引き上げを受けて３．４％高と急伸した。

ゴールドマン・サックスは、同社の投資判断を「中立」から「買い」に引き上げた。コンピューティング能力の供給が逼迫していることや、競合企業に対する業績面での優位性から、今後２年間でメガワット当たりの年間経常収益が押し上げられるはずだとし、直近の下落は買いの好機だとした。前週には、同社の抱える５００億ドルの債務を巡る懸念がＡＩセクター全体に広がり、株価の４分の１超を失っていた。

競合のネビウス・グループは４．５％高。過去２週間で３１％超下落していた。データセンター運営のアプライド・デジタルは９％、ＩＲＥＮは５．７％、それぞれ上昇した。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２．８％高で推移。前週に１１％超下落し、ＡＩ関連の急落局面で最も打撃を受けた銘柄群の一つとなった。

インテルは５．６％上昇した。ＪＰモルガンが投資判断を「アンダーウエート」から「ニュートラル」に引き上げたことが材料となった。

エヌビディアは０．６％、ＡＭＤは４．３％、ブロードコムは２．２％、それぞれ上昇した。３社とも前週に大きく売られていた。

マイクロン・テクノロジーは３．８％高。前週には約１５％下落していた。データストレージのサンディスク、ウエスタン・デジタル、シーゲイトも前週の大幅安から反発した。

items.title: Chorus Aviation buying SkyCare Air Ambulance for $40 million
items.summary: HALIFAX — Chorus Aviation Inc. has signed a deal to buy SkyCare Air Ambulance for $40 million. The company says SkyCare is the largest private fixed-wing air ambulance operator in northern Ontario. It ...
items.body: HALIFAX — Chorus Aviation Inc. has signed a deal to buy SkyCare Air Ambulance for $40 million. The company says SkyCare is the largest private fixed-wing air ambulance operator in northern Ontario. It employs about 220 people across bases in Sioux Lookout, Thunder Bay and Kitchener in Ontario, as well as St. Andrews, Man. SkyCare operates a fleet of 22 aircraft, including turboprops and business jets configured for air ambulance and other specialized missions. Chorus says the purchase price will be funded by $32 million in cash with the remainder payable on or before March 31, 2029, subject to certain performance targets. The acquisition is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 19, 2026.

items.author: CNA

Ex-OpenAI employee accused of planting device appears to have Saudi backing, US prosecutors say

A handout photo shows what the US Justice Department says is Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national employed as an OpenAI engineer, checking a hidden audio recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company, at a location given as San Francisco, California, US, October 5, 2026. US Department of Justice/Handout via REUTERS

A device, which the US Justice Department says is a hidden audio recording device installed in an OpenAI executive conference room by Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national employed as an engineer at the AI company, at a location given as San Francisco, California, US, in this combination handout photo released October 13, 2026. FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : An ex-OpenAI engineer accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company appears to have received considerable support from the Saudi government, US prosecutors said in a court filing.
Federal prosecutors allege that the defendant, Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, was in frequent communication with an unnamed member of the Saudi royal family and that a Saudi military official paid for a one-way plane ticket for Alfozan's wife and young son to return to Saudi Arabia after his arrest, according to the court document, made public late on Sunday.
Prosecutors made those allegations as they asked a federal judge to keep Alfozan in US custody to await trial, arguing he is a flight risk. Alfozan, a Saudi national and lawful permanent resident in the US, is scheduled to appear in federal court in San Francisco later on Monday. 
The case has highlighted security challenges around sensitive AI research as companies and governments compete fiercely for an edge in the transformational technology.

"The defendant went to significant lengths to create customized, encrypted recording devices to secretly record highly sensitive meetings involving senior OpenAI personnel and executives, high-level business counterparts, and government officials, all while communicating with individuals of significance in Saudi Arabia and pursuing opportunities in — and making plans to travel to — Saudi Arabia," prosecutors wrote in a detention memo.
The Saudi government media office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A lawyer for Alfozan did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The lawyer, William Pernik, previously asked for Alfozan to be released from custody, subject to conditions including location monitoring and surrendering his passport, and said Alfozan had spent the last 15 years in the US and had applied to become a citizen.
The lawyer said a planned trip by Alfozan to Saudi Arabia this month was booked before he was under investigation and was for "family and immigration reasons," according to a court filing.
DEVICE INSTALLED BEHIND TV
US prosecutors charged Alfozan last week with using an electronic device to intercept oral communications. Alfozan plugged a recording device into the back of a television in an executive conference room at one of OpenAI's San Francisco buildings, according to a criminal complaint.
Meetings involving government officials took place in the conference room around the time the device was installed, according to the prosecutors' detention memo. 
Prosecutors said the investigation remains active and additional charges could be brought against Alfozan.
A member of the Saudi royal family sought to recruit Alfozan for an AI-focused role in Saudi Arabia, writing in one message, “Saudi needs you more then the US!" Alfozan replied "100," according to messages cited by prosecutors.
Before his arrest, Alfozan was scheduled to fly to Riyadh during a planned two-month parental leave. His wife told investigators that she and their son planned to move permanently to Saudi Arabia and that Alfozan eventually intended to join them, according to prosecutors.
In an Arabic-language interview on the Identity Capital podcast last month, Alfozan said that he visits Saudi Arabia three or four times a year, follows developments there and advises or mentors Saudi startups.
He said meeting Prince Mohammed bin Salman, then deputy crown prince, during a 2016 gathering with young Saudi tech workers in Silicon Valley persuaded him to learn at a top tech company before bringing those skills back home.
While Alfozan was working at Facebook, he and other Saudis in Silicon Valley formed a consulting initiative that linked Saudi public- and private-sector organizations with expertise in big data, the internet of things and machine learning.
OpenAI previously said it discovered the device on September 30 and referred the matter to the FBI.

Source: Reuters

items.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- CoreWeave (CRWV) share are higher in premarket trading as Goldman Sachs upgrades the cloud-computing provider to buy from neutral, a move that comes in the wake of heavy volatility related to concerns over the company’s debt.
- Cleveland-Cliffs (CLIF) shares jumped after it reported third-quarter profit that topped analysts’ estimates as steel prices rose and Trump administration tariffs eroded US imports.
- Intel (INTC) is gaining in the premarket as JPMorgan upgrades to neutral from underweight, noting that the chipmaker’s turnaround might take years, but the management’s execution has been solid. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.body:
[ワシントン　１９日　ロイター] - 米国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）は、米政府の民生部門のＩＴシステムから、中国の新興人工知能（ＡＩ）企業ディープシークの製品および同社製モデルを使用した第三者サービスの排除を命じている。１９日に公表された通知から明らかになった。 

同省はまた、米政府の民生部門によるディープシーク製品およびディープシークを用いて開発された第三者サービスの調達も禁止する。同省は、ディープシークのモデルは「複数の脅威の経路」をもたらすと指摘。米政府職員や取引業者が使用した場合、「機密データが中国に流出する可能性がある」との懸念を示した。

さらに、政府機関によるディープシークの利用は「米国民や政府機関に関し、具体的な工作につながる機密情報を生み出す可能性がある。モデル自体にマルウエアやその他のセキュリティー上の脆弱性が含まれている恐れがある」と指摘した。

ＤＨＳは１９日に公表された７月付のメモで、ディープシークに関する潜在的なリスクに対処するため、政府ウェブサイトを出入りするトラフィックの流れを監視するよう連邦機関に指示した。

これまでに米商務省や海軍を含む複数の機関が、政府支給の端末でのディープシークの使用を禁止しているほか、ニューヨーク、テネシー、バージニア各州など複数の州も同様の措置を講じている。

在ワシントンの中国大使館はコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 19 : Nvidia has won central processor chip business with another fast-growing AI startup that until now relied entirely on chips from Intel and AMD, an early sign that its push into a market long controlled by those two rivals has traction.
Modal, a cloud-computing startup that rents out computing power to AI developers, said it plans to start using Nvidia's new Vera central processor for the first time for hosting agents, the AI systems that can carry out long-running tasks for human users. Modal until now has run such work only on Intel and AMD chips.
Modal last week raised $750 million in a funding round led by Accel at a $15.75 billion valuation, saying it is on track to record $1 billion in sales over the next year. Modal said usage of its services has tripled and revenue has grown more than 15 times year-over-year.
Modal said Monday that early tests showed the new Nvidia chip doubled the amount of work that AI agents can get done, prompting the company to support Nvidia's chip design for the first time, which will require some deep software changes on Modal's side.

But Chief Executive Erik Bernhardsson was careful to stress it is not abandoning its existing suppliers. The company said it will run the Nvidia chips alongside its current Intel and AMD offerings in a mixed fleet, putting each job on whatever hardware runs it best.
Bernhardsson said the tests were run against the Intel and AMD chips already on the market. Both Nvidia rivals are developing newer models that could narrow the gap with Nvidia.
"We'll test them when they're available," he said, adding that running a mixed setup means the company "can always deploy whatever hardware performs best."
Nvidia has told investors it expects to generate at least $20 billion from Vera chip sales this fiscal year, its opening bid for a market it values at roughly $200 billion. Nvidia has previously said OpenAI, Anthropic and Oracle also plan to use the chips, along with AI startups such as Perplexity.

LIVERPOOL, England, Oct 19 : Liverpool must be patient with midfielder Dominik Szoboszlai's recovery from a hamstring injury, while right back Jeremie Frimpong is facing a spell on the sidelines after suffering a fresh muscle problem, head coach Andoni Iraola said on Monday.
• The pair were forced off during Liverpool's 2-1 Premier League win at Brentford on Saturday.

• Frimpong's setback comes after a difficult spell since moving from Bayer Leverkusen last year, with the 25-year-old Dutch international struggling for fitness and form.

items.title: Hungary to cut deficit below 5% of GDP in Magyar's first budget plan
items.author: Gergely Szakacs, Marc Jones
items.creator: Gergely Szakacs, Marc Jones
items.summary: Hungary's budget will target a much lower deficit of 4.9% of gross domestic product in 2027, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Monday as he unveiled the government's draft plan, seen as a credibility test for its ambitions to adopt the euro.
items.body:
Hungary's budget will target a much lower deficit of 4.9% of gross domestic product in 2027, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Monday as he unveiled the government's draft plan, seen as a credibility test for its ambitions to adopt the euro.
Magyar's government inherited an estimated 7.5% of GDP budget shortfall from former prime minister Viktor Orban this year, and its plan is more ambitious than a 5.3% deficit expected by analysts in a Reuters poll last week.
"We need only look around Europe to understand the scale of its significance and what is at stake," Magyar told parliament in a speech presenting the 2027 budget that lasted more than two hours.
"The examples of France or Romania show exactly where it leads when a government is unable to curb overspending, corruption and theft for years," he said. The budget will include a 300 billion forint (826 million euro) contingency reserve.
The announcement of the deficit target sent the forint , central Europe's best-performing currency this year, to four-week highs versus the euro.
Magyar and his government are aiming to narrow the deficit to below the EU's 3% target ceiling by 2030 while still honouring their pledges to voters that helped secure his landslide election win over Orban in April.
Magyar said he would use billions of euros of European Union funds released after the rollback of Orban-era reforms seen as harming democracy to launch large-scale investments in housing, infrastructure and water management to mitigate climate change.
"The 4.9% deficit target appears somewhat better than market expectations going into the announcement, although the key question now is delivery," said Yvette Babb, a fund manager at William Blair.
MAGYAR ADDS MORE THAN $6.2 BILLION OF NEW SPENDING New spending is set to reach more than 2 trillion forints ($6.2 billion) next year, including 449 billion in pension increases, 677 billion in public sector wage hikes, a doubling of the family allowance and tax cuts for more than 2 million people on lower incomes.
Magyar said the phase-out of Orban's pre-election largesse and one-off spending would improve the budget balance by 1.4 percentage points. A wealth tax and tax rises on large companies would add 1 percentage point of revenue, he said.
Cutting back on corruption and public sector overspending would save 1.5 percentage points of output, with lower debt-servicing costs trimming another 0.1 to 0.2 point, he said, bringing the overall fiscal balance improvement to 4 percentage points.
Magyar said he would use 1.4 percentage points of that leeway to deliver on election promises, while the remaining 2.6 points would be used to curb the deficit.
The government will launch a 200 billion forint wealth tax, increase taxes on energy companies by 100 billion forints and raise the corporate tax by 2 percentage points to 11% for companies with annual turnover over €500 million.
Spending to ease the burden of energy price spikes on households, a costly Orban-era measure, which the EU has called on Hungary to eliminate, will remain in place.
The government's aim to adopt the euro has triggered a rally in Hungary's forint , which helped drive inflation below the central bank's target, while bond yields have tumbled this year and are among the lowest in central Europe.
Analysts see Hungary joining the euro in 2032 or 2033.
(1 euro = 363.0084 forints)

items.title: Planta multimillonaria de NGL de TGS entra al RIGI: cuánto exportará desde 2030
items.author: Francisco Aldaya
items.summary: El Comité Evaluador aprobó dos proyectos de la transportista de gas para separar, transportar y exportar líquidos desde Tratayén hasta Bahía Blanca, con un ducto de 577 kilómetros. Qué exportaciones p ...
items.body: Buenos Aires — El Gobierno argentino aprobó este lunes el ingreso al Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones ( RIGI ) de dos proyectos de Transportadora de Gas del Sur ( TGS ) para el tratamiento de los líquidos del gas natural (NGL) de Vaca Muerta, con una inversión de más de US$3.200 millones, anunció el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo. Los proyectos generarán 19.000 empleos durante la construcción y, a partir de 2030, cuando entren en operación, aportarán US$1.100 millones anuales en exportaciones, según el ministro. Se trata de “iniciativas clave para el desarrollo de Vaca Muerta, que incrementan la capacidad de evacuación de la cuenca y permitirán un mayor volumen de producción de hidrocarburos”, dijo el ministro de Economía. VER MÁS: Argentina aprueba inversión RIGI por US$6.400 millones para aumentar producción en Vaca Muerta El primer proyecto, ubicado en Tratayén, Neuquén, consiste en infraestructura para separar los NGL del gas natural. El segundo comprende la construcción de un ducto de 577 kilómetros para transportar esos líquidos y de una planta en Bahía Blanca, donde se fraccionarán y exportarán. TGS había presentado la iniciativa en marzo , en el Argentina Week de Nueva York, como la mayor inversión de la historia para un proyecto de NGL en la Argentina y la mayor de la región. En junio, su directorio tomó la decisión final de inversión y aprobó acuerdos con YPF, Pluspetrol y Chevron para cubrir más de 80% de la capacidad del proyecto, con negociaciones avanzadas con otros productores. En otras palabras, esas energéticas comprometieron volúmenes de gas rico en líquidos para procesar en las plantas de TGS. Así se mueven las acciones de TGS en Wall Street. Símbolo: TGS:UN. Clase de activo: equity. TGS describió entonces un único proyecto de unos US$3.000 millones, con exportaciones estimadas en US$1.200 millones anuales, 4.000 empleos directos y 15.000 indirectos durante cuatro años de ejecución, y puesta en operación en 2030. VER MÁS: La invitación de Marcelo Mindlin a los hyperscalers de la IA: instalen sus datacenters en Vaca Muerta Los componentes clave del proyecto son un gasoducto de segregación de corrientes de gases de unos 100 kilómetros, nuevas instalaciones de procesamiento en la planta Tratayén, un poliducto entre Tratayén y Bahía Blanca, una planta de fraccionamiento y otra de almacenamiento en Bahía Blanca, y obras complementarias en la terminal marítima para exportar. Actualmente, la principal compañía que opera plantas de fraccionamiento de Líquidos del Gas Natural (NGL) en la Argentina es Compañía Mega, de la cual es accionista YPF, junto con Dow y Petrobras. Esa empresa está ejecutando su propia gran inversión: el Gobierno aprobó en agosto el ingreso de Compañía Mega al RIGI (Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones) para un proyecto de US$365 millones. Según TGS, el proyecto resuelve uno de los principales cuellos de botella que podrían limitar el desarrollo de Vaca Muerta. Permite viabilizar el aumento de la producción de crudo y adecuar el gas asociado para su transporte por los gasoductos troncales y de exportación. La compañía ya lidera el procesamiento y despacho de líquidos como etano, propano, butano y gasolina natural desde el Complejo Cerri y Puerto Galván, en Bahía Blanca. No se concretaba un proyecto de procesamiento de líquidos de esta magnitud en más de 25 años, según dijeron al anunciarlo Marcelo Mindlin, de Pampa Energía, y Oscar Sardi, CEO de TGS. El economista Fernando Marull estimó recientemente que el RIGI elevará las exportaciones argentinas en unos US$50.000 millones anuales hacia 2031. De ese salto, US$35.000 millones vendrían de la energía, con el oleoducto Vaca Muerta Oil Sur (VMOS) y el proyecto Argentina LNG de YPF, y US$12.000 millones de la minería, con Vicuña, Los Azules, el nuevo Gualcamayo, Rincón y Veladero. VER MÁS: Glencore invertirá US$4.000 millones en cobre con RIGI y proyecta hasta US$20.000 millones en Argentina Según el gráfico elaborado por el economista en base a información del Boletín Oficial y otras fuentes, las exportaciones con RIGI llegarían a US$171.616 millones en 2031, frente a US$125.327 millones si crecieran a su ritmo histórico. “Dato no menor, el presidente del próximo mandato 2028-2031 va a heredar el mayor impacto del RIGI, porque la mayor parte de las inversiones y de las exportaciones van a ocurrir en 2028-2031”, escribió Marull. El proyecto de TGS sigue ese calendario. Sus plantas entrarán en operación en 2030, dentro del próximo mandato presidencial.

items.title: 仏北部4都市に夜間外出禁止令、首相が極左勢力の暴動関与を非難
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [パリ １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[パリ １９日 ロイター] - フランス当局は１９日、北部リールに１９日１８００ＧＭＴ（日本時間２０日午前３時）から２０日０４００ＧＭＴ（同午後１時）までの夜間外出禁止令を出した。首相府関係者が明らかにした。同関係者によると、夜間外出禁止令は２日間にわたり実施され、北部のドゥエー、ワティニー、ドゥナンも対象となる。

週末に全国で暴動が発生したことを受けた措置。

ルコルニュ首相は、一部地域で夜間外出禁止令を出すよう地方当局に要請していた。首相は、パリ全域を対象とする全面的な夜間外出禁止令は否定したが、非常事態宣言については排除しなかった。ただ、現段階では部分的かつ地域限定の夜間外出禁止令の方がより適切との考えを示し、詳細には触れなかった。 

また、今回の騒乱の一部について極左グループの関与を非難。「大統領選を前に、国内に深刻な混乱を引き起こそうとする極左の動きが確かに存在する。これ以上強い言い方はできない」と述べた。 

これに対し、極左政党「不屈のフランス（ＬＦＩ）」を率いるジャンリュック・メランション氏は強く反発。ルコルニュ首相に対し証拠を示すよう求め、「さもなくば謝罪し、沈黙し、騒乱の火に油を注ぐのをやめるべきだ」とＸに投稿した。 

フランス大統領選の世論調査では、メランション氏と極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏が他の候補者に対するリードを広げ、決選投票で一騎打ちになるとの見通しが示されている。

週末の暴動や略奪の爪痕が残る中、フランスの主要都市の市長らは１９日、治安部隊の準備が不足していたとして政府に説明を求めた。

１７日には、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、同国で過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展した。

商業・小売連盟によると、週末に被害を受けた店舗は約３０００店に上っている。

items.title: 米ロ中首脳、ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議に合わせ会談の可能性＝ロシア大統領報道官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ　１９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ　１９日　ロイター] - ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官は１９日、プーチン大統領、トランプ米大統領、中国の習近平国家主席が来月中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせて３者会談を行う可能性があるとの見方を示し、そうした会談について協議で言及されたと明らかにした。

ペスコフ大統領報道官は、ロシアとウクライナの戦闘終結に向けた協議を行うため、プーチン氏が米ロ中の首脳会談を提案したとする米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）の報道について質問され、「３首脳全員が中国で開かれる首脳会議に参加する可能性があることを踏まえ、そうした会談の可能性が実際に話題に上った」とした上で、「実際に議題に上ったが、会談そのものや会談の議題、内容について具体的な提案や合意が協議されたり、提示されたりしていない」と述べた。

また、米国はロシアとウクライナの戦闘終結に向けた仲介努力を続けており、ロシアはその取り組みを評価していると指摘。最終的な和平合意にはウクライナの参加が不可欠との認識を示した。

米ロ中首脳会談の可能性についてルビオ米国務長官は１９日、訪問先のウズベキスタンで記者団に対し「会談の話は出ている。最終決定したかどうかは分からないが、トランプ大統領の意向は明確だ。大統領はウクライナとロシア間の戦争が終わることを望んでいる」と述べている。

ウクライナのシビハ外相は、米ロ中の首脳による会談の構想を非難。「ウクライナ、米国、ロシアの首脳による３者会談なら、戦争終結の早期実現の一助になり得る。ロシア、中国、米国の首脳による３者会談はその逆の効果しかなく、プーチン氏が戦争を継続することを後押しするだけだ」とＸに投稿した。

items.title: イエメン暫定政府の訓練施設攻撃で53人死亡、フーシ派が犯行声明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１９日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は１９日、同国中南部シャブワ州にある暫定政府治安部隊の訓練施設を攻撃し、５３人が死亡、２００人が負傷した。地元当局が明らかにした。貧困にあえぐ同国での戦闘が激化している。

フーシ派のヤヒヤ・サリー報道官はＸへの投稿で、同派が訓練施設を標的にしたと表明。同施設はサウジアラビア軍が運営していたと主張した。サウジ当局はコメント要請に即座には応じなかった。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた地元当局筋によると、フーシ派は訓練中の治安部隊に向け、弾道ミサイル３発を発射した。シャブワ州はイエメン中南部沿岸に位置するエネルギー資源が豊富な州で、同国最大の産業投資であるバルハフ液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）施設がある。

イエメン暫定政府軍は今月、フーシ派が支配する地域の奪還を目指す作戦を開始し、バベルマンデブ海峡付近の領土を取り戻した。一方、フーシ派は、イエメン南部山岳地帯における反フーシ派勢力の最後の主要都市拠点であるタイズを包囲している。

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : Meta apologized for suspending the Instagram account of the "No Kings" protest movement over the weekend, attributing the shutdown to a sharp increase in activity that looked like automated bot traffic rather than human exchanges.
Demonstrators gathered at thousands of events across the United States on Saturday decrying President Donald Trump's aggressive deportation efforts, war in Iran and other policies in the third round of the "No Kings" rallies.
The Instagram account used by organizers and attendees, however, was offline for more than an hour. And Meta spokesman Andy Stone wrote in a post on X that it took longer to fix problems with organizers' access to the accounts. 
Stone said network security systems detected the use of a Claude tool reading profiles, posts, and hashtags, with the rate sharply increasing in intense bursts on October 17.

"These abrupt, high-volume, sequential requests in a short period resembled automated bot traffic rather than an ordinary human browsing our systems. This activity caused our automated protections to incorrectly take the No Kings Instagram account offline," he said.
"We want to reiterate our sincere apology for the error."
Rally organizers were not satisfied on Monday.
"Meta's explanation still doesn't add up," the No Kings Coalition said on the Bluesky platform. "Beyond shutting down our Instagram, we’ve received reports that NoKings and early voting content was inaccessible, restricted, or seemed suppressed across Meta platforms." 
"Weeks before an election, an apology isn't enough. The public needs answers, accountability, and concrete safeguards," the coalition said.
"No Kings" rallies took place in cities from Seattle and San Diego to Chicago, Atlanta and New York. In Washington, DC, protesters gathered at the site of Trump's proposed triumphal arch to encourage early voting before the November 3 midterm congressional elections.

Source: Reuters

items.summary: WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : The US Supreme Court declined on Monday to hear a challenge by Alphabet's Google to a US Patent and Trademark Office rule that the company argued has insulated older patents from validity reviews and helped fuel a surge in patent litigation.The justices turned away Google's appeal of a lo

Supreme Court rejects Google challenge to US patent agency review policy

FILE PHOTO: Google logo is displayed at Google's headquarters in New York City, U.S., July 1, 2026. REUTERS/Aleksandra Michalska/File Photo

(Updated: 19 Oct 2026 11:03PM)

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : The US Supreme Court declined on Monday to hear a challenge by Alphabet's Google to a US Patent and Trademark Office rule that the company argued has insulated older patents from validity reviews and helped fuel a surge in patent litigation.
The justices turned away Google's appeal of a lower court's decision not to force the agency to reconsider, without using its "settled expectations" rule, the company's challenge to the validity of a patent held by software company VirtaMove. VirtaMove accused Google of infringing the patent.
Google asked the Supreme Court to review the "settled expectations" policy, under which the patent office's Patent Trial and Appeal Board, or PTAB, became more likely to reject requests to review patents that have been in force for more than six years.
Technology companies often use the board's "inter partes review" process to try to cancel patents that they are accused of infringing. The three most active board petitioners between 2020 and 2025 were Samsung, Apple and Alphabet, according to a report from IP company Patexia.

The USPTO during President Donald Trump's administration has introduced measures that have decreased the percentage of reviews the board takes up. 
That figure fell to 37 per cent in 2026 under John Squires, the Trump appointee who heads the patent office, compared to 65 per cent under his predecessor Kathi Vidal, who was appointed by former President Joe Biden, according to an April report from the agency.
The patent office outlined in a memo last year several factors that favor rejecting an inter partes review petition, which the agency has used to deny review for patents that are more than six years old based on the "settled expectations" of the parties.
The patent office cited the "settled expectations" rule in rejecting Google's review petition in 2025 concerning the VirtaMove patent involving server software. The US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit ruled against Google's appeal of the patent office rejection.
Google told the justices in a filing that the rule exceeds the patent office's authority by creating an artificial time limit for board petitions.
"The PTO (Patent and Trademark Office) has no authority to create a limitations period where Congress did not, and it has no authority to expand patent rights beyond what Congress provided," Google said in the filing.
The Trump administration urged the court not to hear Google's appeal.
A group of companies including Google, Apple and Intel has filed a separate lawsuit challenging a related patent office policy. The Federal Circuit ruled against the companies in February, and Intel and Google have also asked the Supreme Court to hear that case.

Source: Reuters

Oct 19 : A decision on Senegal's appeal after being stripped of this year's Africa Cup of Nations title will be made at the end of November, the Court of Arbitration for Sport said on Monday.
Senegal are contesting the Confederation of African Football's decision to declare Morocco champions, despite Senegal beating the hosts 1-0 after extra time in January's final in Rabat, and their arguments, plus those of Morocco and CAF, were heard by CAS in Lausanne on October 8.
At the time, CAS said it expected a decision within days but has now decided to issue a complete ruling, including legal grounds, known as a CAS Award.
“This process will require several weeks, with the CAS Award expected at the end of November 2026,” CAS said in a statement.

Senegal walked off the pitch for 14 minutes after a penalty was awarded against them late in regulation time, with several players returning to the dressing room in protest before they resumed play.
Morocco missed the spot kick, sending the match into extra time, where Senegal scored the winner to secure victory.
However, they were stripped of the title two months later after CAF's Appeal Board ruled that Senegal had forfeited the match by walking off the pitch, overturning the result and awarding a 3-0 victory to Morocco. 
Senegal quickly followed with an appeal to sport's highest court CAS, which was lodged on March 25 but heard some six months later. The basis of their arguments is that the referee’s decision is final and he allowed the match to be completed. 
"I know it's a long wait for the fans a few months after the final between Senegal and Morocco,” CAS Director General Matthieu Reeb said outside the hearing earlier this month.
“I expect the decision to come not today, not tomorrow, but a few days later. The facts are set, are clear and the discussions will be on some procedural issues and legal aspects," he added.
The CAS panel is presided over by French sports law expert Gerald Simon with assistance from Italian international law professor Luigi Fumagalli and Hamburg-based attorney and professor of law at the University of Zurich Ulrich Haas.
CAS decisions are called awards and hold the same value as a national court judgement, enforceable in accordance with the New York Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards. CAS awards may be enforced by sports federations or state courts, depending on the circumstances.

items.title: US Supreme Court to hear Maryland case involving race in school admissions
items.author: Andrew Chung
items.creator: Andrew Chung
items.summary: The US Supreme Court agreed on Monday to consider reviving a lawsuit against a Maryland county's lottery admissions policy for four elite public middle schools that some parents claim unlawfully discriminates against Asian American applicants.
items.body:
The US Supreme Court agreed on Monday to consider reviving a lawsuit against a Maryland county's lottery admissions policy for four elite public middle schools that some parents claim unlawfully discriminates against Asian American applicants.
Delving again into the contentious issue of race in student admissions, the justices took up an appeal by a coalition of parents of a lower court's decision rejecting their claim that Montgomery County's policy violates the US Constitution's 14th Amendment guarantee of equal protection under the law.
The Supreme Court is expected to hear the case and rule by the end of June.
The parents sued to challenge the entrance policies for the county's academically rigorous "magnet" schools, which provide enrichment programs in math and science, or the humanities, for high-achieving students in sixth through eighth grades. They include Takoma Park Middle School in Silver Spring and Martin Luther King Jr. Middle School in Germantown.
The case represents the latest legal attack on entrance policies at certain highly selective public schools that challengers critique for continuing to pursue "racial balancing" with the aim of boosting diversity.
The Supreme Court issued a landmark 2023 [USN:S0N31105H TEXT:"ruling"] that rejected [USN:L1N38L2JO TEXT:"race-conscious"] college and university admissions policies long used to raise the number of Black, Hispanic and other minority students on campuses.
Plaintiffs in these new legal challenges claim that admissions to these prestigious programs, though race-neutral on the surface, use proxies such as socioeconomic status to achieve the same unlawful, race-based result in pursuit of diversity.
The legal challenges coincide with President Donald Trump 's policies, implemented since he returned to office last year, against diversity, equity and inclusion, or DEI, programs in education, as well as in the US government and military, and in private companies.
At issue in the Maryland case is whether lower courts may dismiss claims of intentional racial discrimination if the policy has not disproportionately harmed that racial group, in this instance Asian American students.
Montgomery County is a wealthy suburb of Washington, DC.
The parent coalition, called the Association for Education Fairness, is represented by the Pacific Legal Foundation, a libertarian legal group that has pursued similar challenges in Virginia and Massachusetts. The Supreme Court [USN:S0N3AA01J TEXT:"rejected"] those [USN:S0N3IS01A TEXT:"cases"] in 2024.
"The Constitution protects students as individuals, not as members of a racial group," said Chris Kieser, an attorney for the coalition.
"A school district should not be able to defeat a discrimination claim by showing that its policy did not harm enough Asian American children. Every family deserves admissions rules that judge their child on their own merit," Kieser said.
ENRICHED INSTRUCTION The Montgomery County school district's selection process was introduced in the 2021-2022 school year, during the COVID-19 pandemic. It screens all students for academic potential, and then implements a lottery to randomly assign students from that pool to receive enriched instruction at either a magnet school or a local school.
The lawsuit said that the lottery system led to a lower number of Asian American student placements at the magnet schools.
The suit alleged that the screening process makes it harder for Asian American students, who the challengers said are clustered in "high-performing, low-poverty elementary schools," to enter the lottery pool. Part of the process ranks a student's performance by comparing the student's test scores against those of other students whose family incomes are at a similar level.
US District Judge Paula Xinis threw out the case in 2022, finding that the policy did not place a disproportionate burden on Asian American students. The judge noted that the percentage of admitted Asian American students exceeded the percentage of Asian Americans among all applicants to the magnet schools. Xinis also found that there was no evidence that the lottery policy was implemented with discriminatory intent.
The Richmond, Virginia-based 4th US Circuit Court of Appeals upheld the dismissal, agreeing that the lawsuit "does not plausibly allege that the challenged policy disparately impacts Asian American students."
The Supreme Court's 2023 affirmative action ruling upended decades of precedent, striking down programs used by Harvard University and the University of North Carolina that took race into account as one of many factors in student admissions evaluations.
